name: Passport / पासपोर्ट, Republic of India
mrz_optional: 13 digits then < (meaning not stated) on the 2025 e-passport sample
notes: e-passport (pilot from 1 Apr 2024, nationwide 2025) uses 2 letters + 6 digits (sample SP###### on enwiki fair-use page; Gulf News/Khaleej Times say 2 letters + 6 digits). Pre-e-passport books still in circulation: 1 letter + 7 digits (@#{7}, e.g. J1234567 in third-party docs), valid to expiry. Minors under 15: 5 years or until age 18 whichever earlier; 15-17 may choose 10 years (or till 18). Sample shows issue 03/09/2024 expiry 02/09/2034 (day_before). Sample may be a real person (enwiki fair use): treat example as shape only. Separate 12-char file number is not the passport number.

name: Aadhaar card / आधार (UIDAI); no national identity card in the ICAO sense
notes: Aadhaar is a 12-digit random number (UIDAI); last digit Verhoeff check and first digit not 0/1 per Purview sit-defn-india-unique-identification-number; printed as #### #### ####. Card is a printed letter / optional PVC card, no MRZ, no expiry (mandatory biometric update at 5 and 15). Voluntary; available from birth (Baal Aadhaar). Not a travel document; if the generator needs an MRZ card, treat India as exists=no.

name: Passport of the People's Republic of China / 中华人民共和国护照
number_source: https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_4186634 (Shanghai government 上海发布: prefix E kept, 2nd char letters in sequence excluding I and O, then digits, 9 chars total, first number EA0000001); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_passport
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_passport (Passport Law of the PRC art. 5: 10 years for 16+, 5 years under 16)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Older e-passport series E######## (E + 8 digits, 2012-2017) still valid until ~2027. Pre-2012 97-2 version used G######## (real document seen, shape only: G + 8 digits; issue 26 JAN 2011 / expiry 25 JAN 2021 shows day_before: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Informatin_Page_of_PRC_Ordinary_Passport_(97-2_Version).jpg). Letters I and O never used. Issued by the National Immigration Administration (formerly MPS Exit & Entry Administration).

name: Resident Identity Card / 居民身份证
number_source: GB 11643-1999 citizen identity number (6-digit address code + YYYYMMDD birth date + 3-digit sequence, odd=male even=female + ISO 7064 MOD 11-2 check digit, X=10); https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中华人民共和国公民身份号码 ; Purview sit-defn-china-resident-identity-card-number agrees
notes: Card shows no separate card number: the 18-digit citizen identity number is the document number. Compulsory from 16; under 16 optional (5 years). Validity printed as YYYY.MM.DD-YYYY.MM.DD with the same day and month (common knowledge, not confirmed from a specimen in this survey); 46+ shows 长期 (long-term). Example is the worked example from GB 11643-1999. No MRZ on the card.

name: United States passport (Next Generation Passport book)
mrz_optional: 14 chars; specimen shows "500100120<0958" (internal data, meaning not documented)
notes: State Dept specimen: issued 15 OCT 2020, expires 14 OCT 2030. Next Generation book (2021+) = 1 letter + 8 digits (secondary sources agree: beyondborderglobal, thepointsguy). Pre-2021 books (still in circulation until ~2031) use 9 digits, all numeric (real 2019 book on Commons, shape only: #{9}). Purview "U.S./U.K. passport" = 1 letter or digit + 8 digits, consistent with both. travel.state.gov returned 403.

name: U.S. passport card (federal; state IDs / driver licences out of scope)
mrz_optional: line1 after doc no: "<<10<30<B22<498" (internal codes); line2 optional "075405229"
notes: No national ID card; the passport card (optional, land/sea travel to CA/MX/Caribbean/Bermuda) is the only federal card. Specimen: issued 30 NOV 2009, expires 29 NOV 2019. MRZ document code "IP". Card number always prefixed C, distinct from the passport book number. Same validity as the book.

name: Indonesian passport / Paspor Republik Indonesia
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indonesian_passport_data_page.jpg (2011 specimen: X000000, MRZ X000000<<9); Purview sit-defn-indonesia-passport-number (one or two letters + six or seven digits)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indonesian_passport (10 years for applicants 17+ or married, from 12 Oct 2022; 5 years under 17); https://sippn.menpan.go.id/berita/detil/kantor-imigrasi-kelas-i-tpi-yogyakarta/paspor-masa-berlaku-10-tahun-diterbitkan-mulai-12-oktober-2022 ; specimen 26 JAN 2011 -> 26 JAN 2016; real 2023 polycarbonate e-passport (number redacted) 13 JAN 2023 -> 13 JAN 2033: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Indonesian-passport-pvc-page.jpg
mrz_optional: empty in specimen
notes: Current number format NOT confirmed: the only specimen is the 2011 design (letter + 6 digits, placeholder zeros). Purview allows 1-2 letters + 6-7 digits; widely reported letter + 7 digits for newer books could not be confirmed from an official source or specimen. Before Oct 2022 ordinary passports were 5 years. Missions abroad may issue shorter validity. Data page also shows a 'Reg. No' (e.g. 0A00B00000-XYZ in the specimen) and the specimen photo strip shows a 5-letter + 12-digit code. New red-cover design launched 17 Aug 2024; e-passport only from 2027 (reported).

name: Electronic Resident Identity Card / Kartu Tanda Penduduk Elektronik (KTP-el)
number_source: Purview sit-defn-indonesia-identity-card-number (16 digits: 2-digit province + 4 digits regency/district + DDMMYY birth date, +40 to DD for females + 4-digit serial); https://id.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nomor_Induk_Kependudukan
notes: Card number = NIK (Nomor Induk Kependudukan), 16 digits; region code is the 6-digit Kemendagri code of the registering district (province 2 + regency/city 2 + subdistrict 2). Issued at 17 or on marriage if younger. No MRZ. Pre-2013 paper/plastic KTP had 5-year validity.

name: Passport / پاسپورٹ, Islamic Republic of Pakistan
mrz_optional: probably the 13-digit CNIC (citizenship number) - line 2 of the blurred e-passport sample ends with a single < before the final check digits, consistent with 13 chars + filler; not legible
notes: All Commons data pages are real documents with the number blanked. Number format only from a weak Q&A site (2 letters + 7 digits, e.g. AB1234567); not confirmed - left empty. Data page carries Citizenship Number (= CNIC, #####-#######-#), Tracking Number, Booklet Number and Previous Passport Number. Validity 5 or 10 years (applicant's choice since 2014); under-15s 5 years only (third-party sources). 2010 real document: issue 21 JUN 2010 expiry 20 JUN 2015 (day_before). Polycarbonate e-passport data page since 2022-25.

name: Computerised National Identity Card (CNIC) / Smart National Identity Card (SNIC), قومی شناختی کارڈ (NADRA)
notes: 13-digit CNIC number written #####-#######-#: digit 1 = province (1 KP, 2 FATA, 3 Punjab, 4 Sindh, 5 Balochistan, 6 Islamabad, 7 Gilgit-Baltistan, 8 AJK), digit 2 = division, digits 6-12 family/serial, last digit odd = male, even = female (Wikipedia + python-stdnum + Express Tribune agree). No MRZ on CNIC/SNIC (machine-readable data on NICOP/POC only, per Wikipedia); separate card serial number on the back (format unknown). Over 60: expiry printed Lifetime. 10-year validity only from Wikipedia (not confirmed). Juvenile card for under-18s. NADRA moving to chipless QR card from Aug 2026.

name: Passport (Federal Republic of Nigeria; ECOWAS Harmonised e-Passport)
mrz_optional: NIN (11 digits) as personal number on the current (2019) series
notes: No specimen or issuer statement of the number format found. Blogs (legit.ng, awajis.com) say one letter + 8 digits (hint only, unconfirmed; e.g. @#{8}). Validity: NIS via IRB 2025 (ecoi 2134061): 32 or 64 pages valid 5 years, or 64 pages valid 10 years (applicant's choice); 10-year option introduced with the enhanced e-passport (Jan 2019); en-wiki infobox: adult 5 or 10, minor 5. Regula (regulaforensics.com/blog/nigerian-id-cards-processing): on the latest series the personal-number field carries the NIN, also in the MRZ; earlier series could leave it empty. Polycarbonate data page since 2019 (Keesing). Commons has covers only.

name: National e-ID card (NIMC); new General Multipurpose Card (GMPC)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: NIMC e-ID card (2014): three-line MRZ on back with an ICAO document number (Vanguard 2014 quoting NIMC); the number printed on the front is the payment-card PAN; NIN not printed, only in the NQR code (Regula blog). Card number format not found. NIN: 11 'non-intelligible' random digits (NIMC via IRB ecoi 2134061) -> #{11}. Card for citizens/legal residents 16+ with a NIN (NIMC via IRB). Validity not found. A new ICAO-standard GMPC was announced as the default national ID (IRB 2025); format unknown.

name: Brazilian passport (Passaporte comum)
mrz_optional: empty in specimen (personal number field blank)
notes: Specimen (blue Cruzeiro do Sul model): issued 06 JUL 2015, expires 05 JUL 2025. 2 letters + 6 digits confirmed by secondary sources (Santander blog, brazilian-utils library: no check digit). Validity for minors by age at issue (gov.br table).

name: Carteira de Identidade Nacional (CIN)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Decreto 10.977/2022 art. 3: the CPF number is the registro geral nacional (11 digits, last 2 are mod-11 check digits); art. 11 XII requires an ICAO MRZ. Official mock-up shows 3-line MRZ with placeholder content (not ICAO-valid), so the MRZ document-number field content is unconfirmed. Old state RGs (per-state formats) valid until 28 Feb 2032. Issued by state security secretariats from Nov 2023. Purview RG/RIC patterns are for the old documents.

name: e-Passport / ই-পাসপোর্ট, People's Republic of Bangladesh
mrz_optional: unknown (MRZ not visible on the Commons image)
notes: Only data page on Commons is a real e-passport with all values blurred; no format found from DIP (dip.gov.bd) or press. e-passport since 22 Jan 2020; MRPs remain valid to expiry. Data page has Personal No. (NID or birth registration number) and Previous Passport No. Validity per enwiki infobox: 10 years for 18-65, 5 years under 18 or over 65 (applicants 18-65 may also choose 5). Boundary at 65 ambiguous.

name: National Identity Card / জাতীয় পরিচয়পত্র (Smart NID)
notes: Smart NID (chip card) since Oct 2016; older laminated paper cards (specimen File:NID (Front).png) still exist. NID number length not confirmed from an issuer: commonly 10 digits on smart cards and 13/17 digits on old cards (17 = 13 digits prefixed by birth year) - unverified, left empty. Enwiki infobox gives expiry 15 years; eligibility 16 in infobox but compulsory at 18 per idcards row. MRZ presence unconfirmed.

name: Passport of a citizen of the Russian Federation for travel abroad (Заграничный паспорт гражданина Российской Федерации)
number_example: 72 ####### (real document, shape only: series 72 + 7 digits, MRZ 9 digits)
mrz_optional: empty (filled with <)
notes: Printed as 2-digit series + space + 7-digit number; MRZ document number is the 9 digits without space. Two kinds issued in parallel: biometric "new type" (10 years, any age; image shows series 72, issued 05.02.2014, expires 05.02.2024 -> same_day) and paper "old type" (5 years, any age). Purview "two digits, optional space/hyphen, seven digits" agrees with the specimen. Only series 72 seen here; other series values not confirmed. Validity column = biometric; old-type is 0-:5. format_since 2010 = start of biometric issue (approx., not verified). Real document, shape only.

name: Internal passport: Passport of a citizen of the Russian Federation (Паспорт гражданина Российской Федерации), booklet
validity_source: https://legalacts.ru/doc/postanovlenie-pravitelstva-rf-ot-08071997-n-828/ (Положение о паспорте, Постановление 828; superseded by Постановление 2267 of 23.12.2023 per secondary sources, same age rule)
mrz_optional: Non-ICAO national MRZ on page 3 since 2011: doc code PN, name in Cyrillic-to-Latin substitution table (Ё=2, Й=Q, Ч=3, Ш=4, Щ=W, Ъ=X, Ы=Y, Ь=9, Э=6, Ю=7, Я=8); line 2 pos 1-9 = first 3 digits of series + 6-digit number; expiry field and its check digit are fillers; optional data (pos 29-42) = last digit of series + issue date YYMMDD + 6-digit issuing subdivision code + '<'
notes: Series (4 digits) + number (6 digits), printed "46 01 123456". Series rule: first 2 digits = OKATO code of the region where issued (e.g. 45 Moscow, 40 St Petersburg; some exceptions, 09/39 not region-bound per secondary sources), last 2 digits = year the blank was printed (= roughly year of issue, can differ by 1-3 years). Number: 6 digits, sequential. Issue ages: first issued at 14, replaced at 20 and at 45 (valid until reaching 20 / 45, with 90 days to replace); from 45 no expiry; no expiry date is printed. Separate "subdivision code" NNN-NNN on the data page. MRZ only on blanks issued from mid-2011 (FMS order 279); older ones have none. Purview "10 digits: 2 + 2 + 6 with optional spaces" agrees. Electronic ID card planned, not yet general.

name: Mexican passport (Pasaporte, Estados Unidos Mexicanos; e-passport since Oct 2021)
mrz_optional: CURP likely (CURP is the printed personal number, 18 chars); not confirmed in MRZ
notes: Number format not confirmed: Commons images are a real 2025 e-passport with number blurred (shape ~1 letter + 8 digits, unreadable) and a 2016 page with number removed. Secondary sources say 1 letter + 8 digits (unverified); a 2003 SRE theft notice lists old booklets F4125201-F4128000 (1 letter + 7 digits, old series). PRADO lists a "G series, 2012 model". Validity is chosen by applicant: under 3: 1 or 3 years; 3-17: 3 or 6; 18+: 3, 6 or 10 (1 year only for emergencies). Real 2025 book: issued 29 04 2025, expires 29 04 2031 (6 y, same day).

name: Credencial para votar (INE voter card; de facto national ID, not compulsory)
mrz_optional: line1: "<<" + 13 digits (OCR number, e.g. 0747116375842); line2: "<02<<12345<" in specimen
notes: INE specimen (model E/2019): MRZ doc number = 9-digit CIC. Front also shows Clave de elector (18 chars, @{6}#{8}[HM]#{3}, e.g. GMVLMR80070501M100) and CURP (18 chars, e.g. GOVM800705MCLMLR01). Vigencia printed as years only ("2019 - 2029"), so expiry_rule unknown (expires at end of year per INE practice, not verified). Issued only to citizens 18+ who register to vote.

name: Japanese passport / 日本国旅券
number_source: https://www.pref.saitama.lg.jp/passport/juryo/mikata.html (Saitama Prefecture Passport Center, an issuing office: 旅券番号 = 英字2文字と数字7桁); Purview sit-defn-japan-passport-number agrees (two letters + seven digits)
validity_source: https://www.mofa.go.jp/mofaj/toko/passport/ (5-year or 10-year passport; 10-year only for 18+ since 1 Apr 2022, previously 20+); real 2001 passport on Commons (number blurred): issue 14 AUG 2001, expiry 14 AUG 2006: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Japanese_Passport_Information_page.jpg
notes: Adults (18+) choose 5 or 10 years; minors only 5. No specimen number found. Secondary sources (blog) say 10-year passports start with T and 5-year with M (e.g. TK/TR/TZ, MU...), second letter a series; not confirmed by MOFA. The '2025 passport' (applications from 24 Mar 2025) has a plastic data page; format of number unchanged as far as found. Issued by MOFA via prefectural passport offices.

name: Individual Number Card / 個人番号カード (My Number card / マイナンバーカード)
number_source: Individual Number (My Number) = 11 digits + 1 check digit computed per 総務省令 平成26年第85号: https://support.yayoi-kk.co.jp/faq_Subcontents.html?page_id=19777 ; https://sources.debian.org/src/python-stdnum/2.2-1/stdnum/jp/in_.py
notes: Card is optional; no MRZ. The 12-digit Individual Number is printed on the back; no separate card number is used as the document number. Validity is birthday-based: 18+ at issue: until the 10th birthday after issue; under 18: until the 5th birthday after issue (before 2022-04-01 the threshold was 20). Electronic certificate: 5th birthday regardless of age. Purview 'japan-resident-registration-number' (11 digits) describes the older Juki-net resident code, not My Number. A next-generation card is planned from 2026 (not checked).

name: Philippine passport / Pasaporte ng Pilipinas
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Philippine_passport_(2016_edition)_data_page.jpg (DFA specimen, 2016 edition: P0000000A, placeholder digits); Purview sit-defn-philippines-passport-number (one of its patterns: letter + 7 digits + letter)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippine_passport (Republic Act 10928, 2017: 10 years for 18+, 5 years for minors); specimen shows issue 27 JUN 2016 / valid until 26 JUN 2021
mrz_optional: empty in specimen
notes: Specimen digits are placeholder zeros; shape confirmed only (P + 7 digits + letter). Earlier ePassports (2009-2016) used two letters + 7 digits (e.g. EB/EC series, per Purview's 2-letter+7-digit pattern; not confirmed from a specimen) and may still be in circulation until ~2026. From 1 March 2026 DFA prints document type code 'PP' (not 'P') on regular ePassports (VIZ and MRZ): https://philstarlife.com/amp/article/788915-regular-ph-epassports-to-display-document-type-code-pp-starting-this-march . Pre-2018 adult passports were 5-year. Real document on Commons (Philippine Passport Biometric Data Page.jpg) has number blurred.

name: Philippine Identification Card / Pambansang Pagkakakilanlan (PhilID)
number_source: https://psa.gov.ph/content/psa-begins-issuance-psn-and-philid-successful-registrants (PCN is a 16-digit number printed on the front; PSN is 12 random digits); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Philippine_national_identity_card
validity_source: https://psa.gov.ph/content/philsys-releases-over-1-million-philid-delivery (PhilID of Filipino citizens has no expiration; resident aliens 1 year)
notes: Document number = PhilSys Card Number (PCN), 16 digits, printed grouped in fours (grouping as commonly shown; not confirmed from a specimen); replaced when the card is reissued. The 12-digit PhilSys Number (PSN) is permanent and confidential (microprinted on back). Purview 'philippines-national-identification-number' (12 digits) matches the PSN shape, not the PCN. Registration open to all ages; minimum card age not confirmed. Paper ePhilID and digital ID are equivalent. No MRZ (QR code).

name: Passeport de la République démocratique du Congo / DRC passport
number_source: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/689e03cfb4b6acd341133a02/Notice_Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo_150825.pdf ; https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/ (SDN entry cited in search, OP0######) ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo_passport.jpg
mrz_optional: unknown (blurred)
notes: Pattern is the 2015/2017 (Semlex) biometric series, known only from sanctions lists (UK notice 2025, OFAC SDN: OP0######; real documents, shape only); older OB####### series (UN list CDi.021) is the 2000s series; all non-OB passports were invalidated on 1 Jan 2010; DP/DB = diplomatic. New Dermalog polycarbonate biometric passport launched 5 June 2025 (38 pages); old and new coexist until 2030 (IRB 2026). New-series number format unknown: Commons real document (File:Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo_passport.jpg, real document, shape only) shows MRZ line 2 starting with 'P' (rest blurred), so the new series likely starts with P, not OP. Same image: issued 09/0x/2026, expires 08/0x/203x -> 5 y day_before. Data page has Nom / Postnom / Prénoms fields.

name: Carte d'identité nationale (CIN), planned by ONIP; voter card (carte d'électeur, CENI) used de facto
notes: No national ID card in general issue: Wikipedia says limited issuance began 30 June 2023, but the 2024 ID contract was cancelled and ONIP's ID4Africa 2026 deck still presents the CIN (chip card) and the NIN (Numéro d'Identification National) as plans. Voter card (CENI) is the de facto ID and carries the NIN and a card serial number; formats not found.

name: Ethiopian passport / ፓስፖርት (pasport)
notes: Current number format not found (no data-page specimen on Commons; only covers). Historical only (IRB Canada ETH23780.E, 1996 embassy statements): P + 5 digits 1978-c.1990, then E + 6 digits (@#{6}); not usable for current books. Validity: Wikipedia says 5 years; Addis Insight (dated 2024-10-11, dateline 2017) reports ICS moved to 10 years for citizens aged 25+; under-25 rule not stated, so validity left empty (likely 0-24:5;25-:10, unconfirmed). Locally produced biometric e-passport launched 21 Feb 2025 (https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_6017583). mrz td3 assumed from ICAO-compliant machine-readable booklet, not seen on a specimen.

name: Fayda national ID / ፋይዳ (printed card optional)
notes: Pattern is the 12-digit Fayda Identification Number (FIN) generated by NIDP and sent by SMS; a physical card is issued only on request (id.et/about). A separate card/document number and any 16-digit alias number (FAN) are not confirmed by an official source. Optional (Wikipedia: non-compulsory); legal basis Digital Identification Proclamation 1284/2023. Card validity conflicts: Wikipedia infobox 8 years (unsourced) vs ethio telecom 'card and biometric renewal every 10 years'. MRZ 'none' is an assumption (no specimen seen). Older municipal Kebele ID cards still exist; formats vary by region, not surveyed. [merge 2026-11-04] Card front (Commons Fayda_National_ID_Card_-_Front.jpg) shows the 12-digit FCN, no MRZ on the front, dates in both Ethiopian and Gregorian calendars. Example number not recorded: not confirmed to be a specimen.

name: Passport / جواز سفر
mrz_optional: unknown (blurred on the only data page found)
notes: Real document, shape only: number printed 'A' followed by blurred characters; MRZ line 2 shows 'A'+8 blurred chars before the check digit and EGY, so 9 chars starting with A; digits assumed (not readable). Issue 02/06/2012 -> expiry 01/06/2019 (7 years, day_before). Issuing office code printed (e.g. 18; 88 = diplomatic missions per en-wiki). Data page also carries the 14-digit national number (الرقم القومي). en-wiki infobox: '7 years'; refworld: current passport first issued Jan 2008, valid 7 years. No source found for a minor-specific validity. Other file File:Egyptian_Passport_Bio_Page.jpg is fully blanked.

name: Personal ID card / بطاقة تحقيق الشخصية (national number card, بطاقة الرقم القومي)
notes: Pattern is the 14-digit national number (الرقم القومي), not a card serial: digit1 century (2=1900s, 3=2000s), digits 2-7 birth date YYMMDD, 8-9 governorate code of birth, 10-13 serial (13th digit odd=male, even=female), 14 check digit (algorithm unpublished). Card also prints a separate factory number (رقم المصنع), format not found. No MRZ: back carries a PDF417 barcode (specimen File:Egyptian_ID_Card.jpg, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Egyptian_ID_Card.jpg). Validity 7 years per ar-wiki (expiry printed on cards issued since 2009). Compulsory at 16 under 1994 law; cabinet approved lowering to 15 in July 2022 (ar-wiki).

name: Vietnamese passport / Hộ chiếu Việt Nam (hộ chiếu phổ thông)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:S.R._Viet_Nam_passport_-_early_2023_revision.png (Immigration Department specimen 'BẢN MẪU', 2023 revision: P00000000, MRZ P00000000 + check digit); https://aztax.com.vn/ho-chieu-gan-chip-dien-tu/ (non-chip passports: P + 8 digits; chip passports start with E; secondary source)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_passport (Law on Exit and Entry of Vietnamese Citizens 2019: 10 years for 14+, 5 years under 14, not extendable); real 2022 passport (number blurred) 11/07/2022 -> 11/07/2027: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Biodata_page_of_Vietnamese_passport.jpg ; 2023 specimen expiry 29/12/2032 (issue ..2022)
mrz_optional: personal identification number (12-digit CCCD / ĐDCN number) in the specimen
notes: Pre-2022 design (still valid to ~2032) used letter + 7 digits: specimen B0000000 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vietnamese_Passport_Info_Page.jpg ; other letters (C, N...) reported. Chip e-passports (from 1 Mar 2023) reportedly numbered with leading E (not confirmed from a specimen). From 2022 the data page shows the ID number (Số ĐDCN, CMND) and from 2023 place of birth. Shape of the placeholder only: digits are zeros.

name: Identity Card / Thẻ căn cước (formerly Căn cước công dân, CCCD)
number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_identity_card (12-digit personal identification number: 3-digit province code + century/gender digit + 2-digit birth year + 6 random digits; Decree 137/2015, Circular 07/2016); MRZ document number = last 9 digits per third-party SDK docs https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_cccd_vn (hint only)
mrz_optional: full 12-digit personal identification number (third-party hint, not confirmed from a specimen)
notes: Front shows the 12-digit personal ID number (số định danh cá nhân); province codes run 001-096, so the first digit is always 0. Century/gender digit: 0/1 = 20th c. male/female, 2/3 = 21st c., etc. MRZ (TD1, chip cards since 2021 and the 2024 Căn cước) puts the last 9 digits in the document-number field (per third-party SDK, unconfirmed). Validity is age-milestone based, not N years: card must be renewed at 14, 25, 40 and 60; a card issued within 2 years before a milestone stays valid to the next one; from 60 valid for life. Expiry printed = the milestone birthday. Compulsory from 14; optional from birth (Law 2023 art. 19(3)). Older 9-digit CMND cards are no longer valid.

name: Passport / گذرنامه (Gozarnameh), Islamic Republic of Iran
mrz_optional: likely the 10-digit national code (data page carries شماره ملی) - blank on the template
notes: Enwiki: 'a letter followed by an eight-digit number, e.g. A00000000'; the Persian rendering on the data page omits the leading Latin letter. Commons data page is a blanked template (Washington consulate issue, /06/2017 to /06/2022 = 5 years; numbers removed). Validity per enwiki infobox: 5 years less one day for adults over 18, 10 years in some special cases; minors not stated. Data page also shows national ID number and birth certificate (shenasnameh) number. Ordinary biometric passports since 20 Feb 2011. Men over 19 need proof of military service status (may affect validity, unclear).

name: National Smart Card / کارت هوشمند ملی (Kart-e Hushmand-e Melli); older کارت شناسائی ملی
notes: Pattern is the 10-digit national code (شماره ملی), the main number printed on the card; a separate card serial on the back exists but its format was not found. National code: first 3 digits = issuing city/office code (validator libraries keep a city list; not confirmed by an issuer), digits 4-9 serial (not all zero), digit 10 check: s = sum(d[i]*(10-i), i=1..9), r = s mod 11, check = r if r<2 else 11-r (several independent validators agree); codes of one repeated digit invalid. Commons images (old card and 2015+ smart card) are real cards, blurred: front shows national code, names, birth date, father's name, expiry (پایان اعتبار) - no MRZ seen. Validity 7 years (enwiki/fawiki infobox); expired cards extended to 20 Mar 2027. Compulsory from 15. National code also printed on the passport data page.

name: Ordinary passport / Umuma Mahsus Pasaport (Bordo Pasaport), Republic of Türkiye
mrz_optional: probably T.C. Kimlik No (11 digits; data page has a 'T.C. Kimlik No / Pers. ID No' field) - MRZ blurred, not confirmed
notes: Only data page found on Commons (2018 3rd-gen-style book) is a real, pixelated document: number unreadable. Commonly cited shape U + 8 digits (U12345678) could not be confirmed by any source - left empty. Infobox: 10 years, 5 years if under 18 (or Turkish Cypriot); since 2016 the applicant pays per year and may choose shorter validity. The sample shows issue 2018 / expiry 2028. Biometric since 1 June 2010; generations 2010, 2018, 2022 (domestic production).

name: Republic of Türkiye Identity Card / Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Kimlik Kartı (TCKK)
mrz_optional: 11-digit T.C. Kimlik No (national ID number), line 1 positions 17-27 (specimen: 22345678902)
notes: Official 'ÖRNEKTİR' sample back side: I<TURA12Z345676<22345678902<<< / 7506121M2610041TUR<<<<<<<<<<<1 / ANKARA<<KAAN. Document (serial) number is letter + 2 digits + letter + 5 digits; enwiki example A12B34567 has the same shape (both look like placeholders, so placeholder level). A 2024 real card on Commons (redacted) confirms the TD1 layout. T.C. Kimlik No: 11 digits, first digit non-zero, digit 10 = ((sum odd positions 1,3,5,7,9)*7 - (sum even 2,4,6,8)) mod 10, digit 11 = sum of first 10 mod 10 (Purview: 11 digits with checksum). Card compulsory from birth; photo required from 15. Chip cards since 2 Jan 2017 valid 10 years (no age split found); old paper nüfus cüzdanı (lifetime) phased out. Back shows a 6-digit PEN number.

name: German passport (Reisepass)
number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/German_passport (citing BMI 'Die Dokumentennummer in deutschen Ausweisen und Pässen', https://www.bmi.bund.de/SharedDocs/downloads/DE/veroeffentlichungen/themen/moderne-verwaltung/ausweise/personalausweis-seriennummer.pdf - BMI server returned HTTP 400 to us); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-germany-passport-number
notes: 9 characters: first is always a letter (Purview: C,F,G,H,J,K = passport), then 8 from digits and C F G H J K L M N P R T V W X Y Z (no vowels, no B D Q S U). Structure: 4-character issuing-authority code (Behördenkennzahl) + 5 random characters; check digit only in the MRZ. Since 1 Nov 2007 alphanumeric pseudorandom (before: 9 digits sequential); digit 0 no longer used since 1 Nov 2021 (older documents may contain 0, so [CFGHJKLMNPRTVWXYZ0-9] for pre-2021 issues); before 1 Nov 2023 the number could exceptionally be all letters. MRZ uses nationality code 'D' (not DEU). Validity: PassG §5 - 10 years, 6 years under 24 (Kinderreisepass abolished end 2023). Expiry relation to issue date not verified (Commons specimen not reachable, HTTP 429; BMI site blocks).

name: German identity card (Personalausweis)
number_example: T22000129 (BMI 2010 Erika Mustermann specimen; MRZ T220001293)
number_source: https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personalausweis_(Deutschland) (structure: authority code chars 1-4, random 5-9, check digit 10); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-germany-identity-card-number; https://www.php-einfach.de/?p=971 (specimen number T220001293)
notes: Card number = 9 characters: 4-character issuing-authority code + 5 random characters; check digit appears only in the MRZ (line 1: IDD<<T220001293<<<...). Purview: first letter L M N P R T V W X Y for ID cards, rest from digits and C F G H J K L M N P R T V W X Y Z; same alphabet/0-rule as the passport (0 dropped from 1 Nov 2021; specimen T22000129 is pre-2021 and contains 0, so older cards use [CFGHJKLMNPRTVWXYZ0-9]). Check digit of specimen verified (7-3-1 over T22000129 = 3). Cards of 1987-2010 had 10 digits (all expired by 2020). Compulsory from 16 (or passport); can be issued at any age since 1 Nov 2007. PAuswG §6: 10 years, 6 years under 24. No personal/national number exists in Germany. Nationality code 'D' in MRZ.

name: British passport (United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland passport)
notes: HMPO 'Basic passport checks': number is '9 numerical digits' (all series 1988-2025, printed on page 1 and biodata page); separate thin-film serial (3 letters + 4 digits + check symbol, from 2010) is NOT the passport number. Since 10 Sep 2018 adult passports 'expire 10 years after the date of issue' (child 5 years), so same_day is taken from the issuer text, not confirmed on a specimen; before 2018 up to 9 extra months were carried over (10y9m / 5y9m max). Child = under 16 (gov.uk). Series C (2020, blue, polycarbonate) and D (2025). No example: Commons specimen not reachable (HTTP 429); Purview 'us-uk-passport-number' (letter or digit + 8 digits) is looser than the issuer. Number prefix structure unknown. MRZ optional field content not checked.

name: (none) - Identity Card (Identity Cards Act 2006) abolished
notes: The UK issues no national identity card: the voluntary cards issued 2009-2010 were cancelled by the Identity Documents Act 2010 (cards invalid from 21 Jan 2011). Wikipedia 'Countries with no identity cards' agrees. Driving licence / passport used instead.

name: Tanzanian passport / Pasipoti (East African Community e-passport)
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons has only covers). Current e-passport number format unknown. Older (pre-2018 green) passport: a 2020 Court of Appeal judgment cites a real passport number of shape @{2}#{6} ('AB' + 6 digits; real document, shape only; https://www.scribd.com/document/562085938/Anundo-vs-Tz) - not confirmed for the e-passport. EAC e-passport issued from 31 Jan 2018; old passports withdrawn Jan 2020. Validity 10 years from issue (news + Wikipedia infobox); child rule not found. td3 assumed (ICAO-compliant e-passport), not seen on a specimen.

name: National Identity Card / Kitambulisho cha Taifa (NIDA)
notes: Optional in law but needed for SIM registration etc. The holder number is the 20-digit National Identification Number (NIN, #{20}; NIDA/ID4Africa presentations); its internal layout (often said to start with date of birth YYYYMMDD) is NOT confirmed by an official source. A separate card serial number exists? unknown. Cards first issued Feb 2013 with 10-year validity; in Feb 2023 the government removed expiry dates (validity 0 = no expiry for current cards; older cards print an expiry that is no longer enforced). Eligibility 18+ (NIDA presentation; review to lower to 15 under discussion).

name: French passport (Passeport)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:French_passport_data_page_sample.jpg ; Microsoft Purview sit-defn-france-passport-number (2 digits + 2 letters + 5 digits, agrees)
mrz_optional: empty
notes: Specimen SPECIMEN ABB Natacha: no. 90RF02331, MRZ P<FRASPECIMEN<ABB<<NATACHA / 90RF023318FRA7307122F2903035<<<<<<<<<<<<<<02. Issue date 05 03 2019 but expiry 03 03 2029 (issue + 10 y - 2 days), so neither same_day nor day_before; expiry may be computed from another date (e.g. application/production) - left unknown. Meaning of the 2 leading digits (possibly year of manufacture) and the 2 letters not documented by the issuer. Purview and the US-embassy ESTA example (12XX34456) agree on shape. No national personal number in France's MRZ.

name: French national identity card (Carte nationale d'identité, CNIe)
validity_source: https://www.service-public.gouv.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F1341 (adults: 'La carte est valide pendant 10 ans'); décret 55-1397 as amended by décret 2021-279 (10 years; minors' cards were already 10 years)
mrz_optional: empty (line 1 after check digit and line 2 optional field all '<')
notes: Specimen MARTIN Maëlys-Gaëlle: document no. X4RTBPFW4 (letters and digits mixed, 9 chars), issued 12 02 2020, expires 11 02 2030 (day_before); MRZ IDFRAX4RTBPFW46<<<... / 9007138F3002119FRA<<<<<<<<<<<6 / MARTIN<<MAELYS<GAELLE<MARIE. Exact character set/structure of the new number not documented by the issuer (pattern *{9} is only the shape; specimen uses no O/0 or I/1 but that is not confirmed as a rule). Card issued since 15 Mar 2021 (generalised 2 Aug 2021), no age limit, free. Old laminated card (1988/1994-2021): 12-digit number YYMM (issue) + 3-char department/office code + 5-digit serial(+ check), MRZ was a non-ICAO 2x36 format; adult cards issued 2004-2013 carry an automatic 15-year validity (décret 2013-1188), so old cards circulate until ~2031. Purview 'France national ID card' (12 digits / 12 or 9 alphanumerics) matches both formats.

name: Thai passport / หนังสือเดินทางไทย
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Third_Version_Thai_Biometric_Passport.jpg (real 2021 third-version e-passport, number blurred: prefix AC visible, previous passport prefix AA in the observations page; MRZ number field is 9 characters filled before the check digit)
validity_source: https://www.bangkokbiznews.com/news/926987 (10-year passport for applicants 20+, fee 1,500 baht; 5-year passport 1,000 baht); https://www.nationthailand.com/news/30403570 (fees effective 11 Mar 2021); specimen: issue 03 FEB 2021, expiry 02 FEB 2026
mrz_optional: probably the 13-digit personal identification number (data page shows 'Identification No.'; MRZ optional field blurred, not confirmed)
notes: Real document, shape only: 2 letters + 7 digits (letters appear to advance in series AA -> AC; digits assumed from MRZ length, not seen). Adults 20+ may choose 5 or 10 years; under 20 only 5 years. Data page also prints the 13-digit national ID number. No Purview definition for Thai passports. No official statement of the number format found.

name: Thai National ID Card / บัตรประจำตัวประชาชน
number_source: Purview sit-defn-thai-population-identification-code (13 digits, first not 0 or 9); https://th.wikipedia.org/wiki/เลขประจำตัวประชาชนไทย (13 digits, first = person category, last = mod-11 check digit)
validity_source: https://mgronline.com/south/detail/9540000083487 (8 years from the holder's first birthday after the issue date; previously 6 years); https://www.thaipbs.or.th/news/content/21698 (first card at 7 since 2011)
notes: Card number on front = 13-digit personal identification number, usually printed 1 2345 67890 12 3. Expiry falls on the holder's birthday: 8 years counted from the first birthday after issue (so ~8-9 years). Holders 70+ get a lifetime card. The back carries a separate laser/serial code (shape not confirmed). No MRZ.

name: South African passport / Suid-Afrikaanse paspoort
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_African_passport (citing DHA: regular/maxi 16+ valid 10 y, child <16 valid 5 y)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen data page found (Commons throttled; none in en/fr wiki). Shape from real documents on sanctions lists, shape only: OFAC SDN lists an SA passport M######## issued 2010-05-04 expiring 2020-05-03 (=> 10 y, day_before); OpenSanctions lists one A0#######. Letter likely series (A ordinary 32 p, M maxi 48 p?) - meaning unconfirmed. Third-party regex101 entry also says 1 letter + 8 digits (hint only). No Purview definition. 2025 reform announced biometric e-passports; numbering of the new series unknown. Holder's 13-digit ID number is printed on the data page (Wikipedia field list).

name: Smart ID card / National Identity Card (green barcoded ID book still valid until phase-out, 2028 announced)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:ZA_Smart_ID_Front.png (DHA sample card shows date of issue only, no expiry date)
notes: Card has no MRZ: reverse carries Code 39 barcode (ID number) and PDF417 (incl. 9-digit card number), Regula blog + en wiki. Card number = 9 digits on reverse (sample 123456789). Personal identity number (13 digits, on front, also on passport): YYMMDD SSSS C A Z; SSSS 0000-4999 female, 5000-9999 male; C 0 citizen, 1 permanent resident, 2 refugee; A formerly race, now 8 (or 9); Z Luhn check digit. Pattern #{6}#{4}[012][89]#. Sample front shows 13-digit 0123456789... placeholder. Compulsory from 16 (Wikipedia idcards list). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_African_identity_card ; https://regulaforensics.com/blog/south-african-ids-verification/

name: Italian passport (Passaporto)
number_source: https://www.astrid-online.it/static/upload/MinA/MinAffEsteri-23_06_09.pdf (Ministero degli Affari Esteri: 'sequenza alfanumerica di due lettere indicanti tipologia e serie del passaporto, seguite da sette numeri arabi'); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-italy-passport-number (looser: 2 letters or digits + 7 digits)
notes: Two letters = passport type and series (which letter pairs are current not found; 'YA', 'YB' commonly seen but unverified), then 7 digits. Validity per Polizia di Stato/Questura form: 3 years under 3, 5 years 3-18, 10 years adults. Specimen data page on Commons (Itpassportbiodata.jpg) not read - Commons rate-limited (HTTP 429). Expiry relation unknown.

name: Italian electronic identity card (Carta d'identità elettronica, CIE 3.0)
number_example: CA00000AA (issuer page prints 'CA000000AA', apparently a typo given its own 2-5-2 rule)
number_source: https://www.cartaidentita.interno.gov.it/info-utili/caratteristiche-del-documento/ ('2 lettere - 5 numeri - 2 lettere', Numero Unico Nazionale)
notes: CIE 3.0 serial = 2 letters + 5 digits + 2 letters (different from the old paper card, e.g. AA1234567 / AS1234567, still in limited circulation until withdrawal in Aug 2026 under Reg. 2019/1157). Expiry: the CIE expires on the holder's birthday (day and month of birth) following the end of the 3/5/10-year term - several municipal sources agree on intent but differ in wording; generator should set expiry = first birthday on/after issue+N years (not verified on specimen). No minimum age (limit of 15 removed by DL 70/2011). The card also shows the codice fiscale (16-char tax code) as the personal number; whether it appears in the MRZ optional field was not verified.

name: Kenyan passport / Pasipoti (East African Community e-passport)
notes: Commons bio page (real document, number and MRZ redacted) of the 2017 e-passport: holder born 20 JAN 2000, issued 27 JUL 2017, expires 26 JUL 2027 -> 10 years day_before even for a 17-year-old; 'Personal No.' field present (national ID / birth number, partly visible, digits); authority 'PASSPORT CONTROL NAIROBI'. immigration.go.ke: valid for a maximum of ten years; minors also 10 years (Wikipedia). Number format not confirmed: Wikipedia only says 'mixture of letters and numbers'; KYC vendor regex [A-Z0-9]{7,9} with placeholder A00000000 (hint only). E-passport since Sept 2017; old (pre-EAC) passports invalid from 1 Dec 2022 (kenyahctz.org).

name: National Identity Card / Kitambulisho cha Taifa; since 2023 Maisha Card (3rd generation)
notes: Compulsory from 18 (Wikipedia). Maisha Card (from Nov 2023): 10-year validity (chip life), ICAO-compliant MRZ on back (td1 per sources, not seen on a specimen), card serial number on front (format not found). Holder number: Maisha Namba / UPI - sources conflict (9 vs 14 digits); holders of 2nd-generation IDs keep their ID number as UPI. 2nd-generation card (1995-2023, no expiry, still in circulation) shows an ID number (7-8 digits, unconfirmed) and a separate serial number. No specimen found; Commons rate-limited.

name: Pasaporte colombiano (ordinario)
mrz_optional: personal number = ID-type prefix + ID number, e.g. "CC4364573" (CC cédula de ciudadanía, TI tarjeta de identidad)
notes: 2026 Imprenta Nacional specimen: CB007001, document type "PP", issued 01 ABR 2026 expires 01 ABR 2031 (5 years - conflicts with the 10-year rule; specimen may be illustrative). Real 2021 book (shape only): 2 letters "AX" + 6 digits, type "P", issued 21 OCT 2021 expires 21 OCT 2031 (10 y, same day). Number changes at every issuance. Since Dec 2024 (Res. 12880) minors no longer must renew at 18 / when getting tarjeta de identidad.

name: Cédula de ciudadanía (cédula digital since 2020); minors 7-17: Tarjeta de identidad
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Pattern is the NUIP (lifelong personal number): since 2004 numbering starts at 1.000.000.000 (10 digits); citizens documented before 2003 keep older 8-digit (or shorter) numbers (Purview: 2 digits + 6 digits, or 1 + 9 digits). Real card on Commons (shape only): NUIP 1.000xxxxxx, issued 2018, expires 2032 (does not match 10 y). Cédula digital (Dec 2020) has an ICAO 9303 MRZ on the back, but the MRZ document-number field content (card serial vs NUIP) is not confirmed from a specimen. Old yellow hologram cédulas have no expiry.

name: Passport / جواز سفر (Republic of the Sudan, electronic passport)
mrz_optional: unknown (11-digit national identity number printed on the data page)
notes: No specimen or issuer statement of the number format found (Commons/en-wiki: covers only; uqudo field reference gives no example). Landinfo 2023 (citing DISCS and Norwegian ID Centre 2018): e-passport introduced 2008 (others say 2009), data page carries passport number and the 11-digit national identity number (printed since 2011); ordinary passports valid 5 years adults, 2 years children; new version with full English name from 2012. Conflict: en-wiki infobox says 10 years adults / 5 years minors (unsourced; may reflect a later change) - not confirmed. IRB 2017 (The National 2012): 48-page citizen passport 5 years, 64-page commercial passport 7 years. Issued by the General Directorate for Passports and Migration. Age boundary for 'children' assumed 18 (consent needed under 18).

name: National identity card / البطاقة القومية (بطاقة الهوية)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Landinfo 2023: ID cards with the national identity number issued since 2011 by the General Directorate of Civil Registration; new 'smart' chip card announced 14 Oct 2017; card-size, front shows photo and the national identity number (Arabic + western numerals), back has chip, barcode and an MRZ field (line count not stated, so mrz=unknown; TD1 likely) and issue/validity; normally valid 5 years (DISCS). Compulsory above 16 (Civil Registry Act 2011 art.27), exceptionally under 16. National identity number: 11 digits (ar-raqm al-watani), unique, assigned on civil registration, structure not published (#{11}). Card document-number format not found. Card production halted 2021; expired cards accepted until 30 June 2022.

name: Myanmar passport / မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ နိုင်ငံကူးလက်မှတ်
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Myanmar_passport_biodata_page.JPG (real 2014 passport, number blurred: visible prefix MA, MRZ number field ends '<' before the check digit, i.e. 8 characters)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Myanmar_passport (red ordinary passport valid 5 years; green official 3 years); real document issue 2014 -> expiry 2019 (day/month blurred)
notes: Real document, shape only; digit count inferred from the MRZ ('MA' + ~6 blurred characters + '<' + check digit), not read directly. Document type code is two letters (PV on this one); Myanmar issues several ordinary passport sub-types (visit, employment, seaman, etc.; '9 types of passports': http://www.moi.gov.mm/moi:eng/?q=news/31/10/2016/id-8966), each with its own type code. Machine-readable since April 2010; e-passport plans not checked. Issuing authority printed as 'MOHA, YANGON'.

name: Citizenship Scrutiny Card / နိုင်ငံသားစိစစ်ရေးကတ်ပြား (National Registration Card, NRC)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:National_Registration_Card_of_Myanmar_Front.jpg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:National_Registration_Card_of_Myanmar_Back.jpg (described as a 'sample', 2013, but appears to be a real card: shape only)
notes: Real document, shape only. Hand-written laminated pink card, no MRZ. Front 'အမှတ်' (number) field holds the NRC number in Burmese script: state/region number (1-14) / township abbreviation (3 Burmese consonants) (citizenship type, e.g. နိုင် = Naing, full citizen) + 6 digits, all in Burmese numerals; romanised commonly as e.g. 12/XXX(N)123456 (structure read off the card, romanisation not confirmed by an official source). Back shows a separate card serial: one Latin letter + 6 digits (shape @#{6}). Issue date written on the front; no expiry date visible. Compulsory per Wikipedia's ID-card policy list. A new digital/unique ID (e-ID) scheme was announced but not checked (web search budget exhausted).

name: Republic of Korea passport / 대한민국 여권
number_source: https://www.mcst.go.kr/site/s_notice/press/pressView.jsp?pSeq=16931 (government press release on the next-generation e-passport: 여권번호 체계 변경(영문자 1자리 추가) M12345678 -> M123A4567, to relieve number exhaustion); MOFA specimen https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Identity_Page_South_Korea_New_Passport.jpg (M123A4567); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korean_passport (M = multiple-journey PM, S = single-journey PS)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Korean_passport (10 years 18+, 5 years under 18); specimens: 15 AUG 2020 -> 15 AUG 2030 (new), 15 APR 2014 -> 15 APR 2024 (old)
mrz_optional: new design: 'V2' + zeros in specimen; old design: 7-digit second half of the resident registration number + 'V' + digits (specimen 2154710V1762788)
notes: Next-generation passport issued from 21 Dec 2021. Older series (2008-2021, still valid until ~2031): [MS]#{8}, specimen M70689098 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Specimen_Personal_Information_Page_South_Korean_Passport.jpg (old data page also printed the personal no. = back 7 digits of RRN; new design omits it). Purview pattern ([MSROD] + 8 digits or + 3 digits + letter + 4 digits) agrees; R/O/D are other passport types. Shorter-validity passports exist for men subject to military service and on request (<5 years).

name: Resident Registration Card / 주민등록증
number_source: Purview sit-defn-south-korea-resident-registration-number (13 digits YYMMDD-NNNNNNN); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resident_registration_number ; MOIS reform Oct 2020 (region code replaced by random digits): https://www.segye.com/newsView/20191219516251
notes: The card's main number is the 13-digit resident registration number (YYMMDD + gender/century digit 1-4 (also 5-8 for foreigners, 9/0 for 1800s) + 6 digits). Since Oct 2020 newly assigned numbers have 6 random digits after the gender digit (no region code, no check digit); older numbers keep region code + check digit (mod 11). No printed expiry: the card does not expire (validity 0); issue date only. Compulsory at 17. No MRZ. Mobile ID card since 2024. Format of any separate card serial not found.

name: Spanish passport (Pasaporte español)
number_source: https://www.bbva.es/finanzas-vistazo/ef/finanzas-personales/cual-es-el-numero-de-pasaporte-en-espanol-y-como-se-obtiene.html (3 letters + 6 digits, check character only in MRZ); https://legalteam.es/no-cometas-este-error-pasaporte/ (Policía: first 3 characters always letters, 'PAO' is letter O); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-spain-passport-number (looser)
mrz_optional: DNI number (8 digits + letter) expected in personal-number field - not verified on a specimen
notes: Pattern from two secondary sources agreeing (no issuer text found); prefixes seen as 'PA?' (e.g. PAO...), meaning of letters unknown. Validity RD 896/2003 art 5.1: 5 years under 30, 10 years from 30, 2 years under 5; passports for under-14s without DNI capped at the 14th birthday. Example not taken (Commons ESPpassportdatapage.png not reachable, HTTP 429). Purview says 2 chars + optional char + 6 digits (8-9), wider than the observed 3 letters + 6 digits.

name: Spanish national identity card (Documento Nacional de Identidad, DNI 4.0)
number_source: https://www.catastro.hacienda.gob.es/ayuda/ayuda_idesp.htm (número de soporte/IDESP: 'Su formato es AAA000000'); https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2025-6601 (RD 255/2025 art. 12: número de soporte on front, 3 MRZ lines x 30)
mrz_optional: DNI personal number (8 digits + check letter) in line 1 optional field - from memory of specimens, not verified
notes: MRZ document number = número de soporte (IDESP on DNI 3.0, 'NUM SOPORTE' on DNI 4.0), 3 letters + 6 digits, changes with every card. The personal DNI number (NIF) is separate and permanent: 8 digits + check letter = 'TRWAGMYFPDXBNJZSQVHLCKE'[n mod 23]. RD 255/2025 (in force 2 Apr 2025, replaces RD 1553/2005): validity 2 years under 5, 5 years 5-29, 10 years 30-69, and from 70 'más de diez años ... consignando una fecha' (under RD 1553/2005 it was permanent, printed 'PERMANENTE'/01 01 9999); validity '0' here = the old permanent rule, check RD 255/2025 for the date now printed. Compulsory from 14 for residents in Spain; obtainable at any age. DNI 4.0 (2021) follows Reg. 2019/1157.

name: Passeport biométrique électronique / جواز السفر البيومتري الإلكتروني
mrz_optional: unknown (the 18-character NIN is printed on the passport)
notes: Number format not found (no data-page specimen on Commons; en-wiki has the cover only). Biometric e-passport issued since January 2012 (Ministry of Interior, ID4Africa 2026 presentation https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf; technical characteristics in arrêté of 26 Dec 2011). Validity 10 years adults, 5 years minors (Algerian consulate NY via IRB ecoi 2021329); majority is 19 in Algeria (en-wiki: 'Adult/+19 years', 'Minor/-19'). NIN (decree 10-210 of 2010) printed on passport.

name: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique électronique (CNIBE) / بطاقة التعريف الوطنية البيومترية الإلكترونية
mrz_optional: unknown (NIN likely)
notes: CNIBE issued since January 2016 (Ministry of Interior, ID4Africa 2026), ICAO-compliant (TD1 MRZ expected; not seen on a specimen). Card number format not found. NIN: 18 characters built from civil-status data (sex, birth record, place of birth, naturalisation) per INA presentation ID4Africa 2019 (https://www.id4africa.com/2019_event/presentations/InF3/4-Abderrazak-Henni-MOI-Algeria.pdf); exact layout not found. Validity 10 years (consulate via IRB). Compulsory (en-wiki); minimum age not found.

name: Pasaporte argentino (República Argentina, Mercosur)
mrz_optional: DNI number, 8 digits (e.g. 99999999)
notes: RENAPER Disp. 1/2023 annex: number alphanumeric, 3 letters + 6 digits ("ZZZ" in specimens), MRZ travel document number 9 chars, DNI printed as personal number. Specimen: issued 18 JUN 21, expires 18 JUN 26 (same day). Older passports used a 9-digit all-numeric sequential number (en.wikipedia), still possibly in circulation only if issued <10y ago. 2026 revised booklet (Disp. 54/2026) keeps format per available info.

name: Documento Nacional de Identidad (DNI), tarjeta
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: DNI number is lifelong, 8 digits (Purview: ##.###.### with optional dots; real card on Commons, shape only, MRZ starts IDARG with ~8-9 char number). Under 14: card valid until the mandatory update (between 5 and 8, then at 14); from 14: 15 years. Card also carries a número de trámite and an ejemplar letter (A original, B, C... for replacements). Over-75 exemption from renewal reported (unclear in 2026). MRZ number-field filler/check layout not confirmed from a specimen.

name: Passport / جواز سفر (Jawaz Safar) / پاسپۆرت, Republic of Iraq (B series)
mrz_optional: 12 digits then << : looks like the 12-digit national card (unified ID) number; specimen 198063980372
notes: Official specimen (B series, 2023) shows number B00000000 (series letter B + 8 digits, all zeros = placeholder; shape only) also perforated on page 1. Enwiki says 9 alphanumeric chars from 0-9 and C F G H J K L M N P R T V W X Y Z - that text is copied from Purview's UAE pattern and conflicts with the B-series specimen (B is not in that set). Earlier A series (2010-2023) presumably A + 8 digits (not verified). Specimen issue 06.03.2023 expiry 05.03.2031 = 8 years, day_before. Under-16 validity 4 years (enwiki; boundary unverified).

name: Iraq National Card / البطاقة الوطنية (al-Bitaqa al-Wataniya) / کارتی نیشتمانی
mrz_optional: 12-digit national identification (personal) number, line 1 positions 16-27 (enwiki table; uqudo: opt1 = personal number)
notes: Enwiki MRZ table: line 1 = ID IRQ + 9-char 'access number for RFID chip' (2 letters + 7 digits) + check digit, then the 12-digit number it calls 'document number'. In ICAO TD1 terms positions 6-14 are the document-number field, so the pattern given is the 2-letter + 7-digit card number; the 12-digit national number sits in the optional field (uqudo API lists opt1 = personal number). Front also shows the 12-digit national number; back shows an 18-character family number (sijil). No specimen found, so no example. Biometric card since late 2015/2016, compulsory for all citizens; minimum age not found. Iraqi passport B-series specimen MRZ optional data is 12 digits starting with the holder's birth year (198063980372), consistent with the national number possibly starting with YYYY of birth (unverified).

name: Ugandan passport (East African Community e-passport)
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons: covers only). Number format unknown; PRADO notes diplomatic numbers start 'DA' (search snippet), ordinary prefix unknown. Validity: Passports Act 1982 set 5 years, since raised to 10 (Wikipedia, unsourced on minors). EAC e-passport launched Jan 2019; machine-readable (non-e) passports phased out by April 2022; polycarbonate data page variant from 31 Mar 2023 (https://www.envoyglobal.com/news-alert/uganda-updated-e-passport-documents/). td3 assumed.

name: National Identity Card / Ndaga Muntu (NIRA)
notes: Compulsory. Holder number: NIN, 14 alphanumeric characters (several secondary sources); third-party validator (hint only, not confirmed) describes C[MF]##@... : class C=citizen, gender M/F, 2-digit birth year, 10-char serial (e.g. shape CM90012345678X); a separate card number exists on the card but its format was not found. Cards issued 2014 with 10-year validity; expiries extended repeatedly 2024-2026 during mass renewal; NIN never changes. Mass enrolment covers citizens 16+ (allafrica 2025); children registered with NIN but card from 16.

name: Passport / پاسپورت (Islamic Republic of Afghanistan; General Directorate of Passports, Ministry of Interior)
mrz_optional: 13-digit national ID (e-Tazkira) number appears in the passport (enwiki idcard policy row); MRZ placement not seen
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons and all-language wikis have covers only; PRADO 403). French OFPRA/ecoi note: passports issued in Afghanistan since January 2018 have a number preceded by the letter P; earlier e-passports (versions 01001 2012-2015, 01002 from Jan 2016) by the letter O; consulates abroad may still issue O-series, valid until expiry. Digit count not found (likely letter + 8 digits, unconfirmed; older handwritten books were 2 letters + 6 digits, invalid since Nov 2017). Validity: 5 or 10 years chosen by fee (5,000 / 10,000 AFN, enwiki 2018), ecoi specimen 2013 valid 5 years. Taliban-era (post-2021) books continue the Islamic Republic design.

name: Electronic Tazkira (e-Tazkira) / تذکره تابعیت الکترونیکی (National Statistics and Information Authority, NSIA)
notes: Pattern is the 13-digit national identification number printed 0000-0000-00000 (enwiki); a German state decree (Flüchtlingsrat NRW) also says 13 digits but writes the grouping xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx (inconsistent). Whether the MRZ document-number field holds this number or a separate card number is unknown (13 digits would overflow the 9-char field, so likely a separate number or a split). Commons 2025 card (real, redacted) shows expiry in Solar Hijri (1414/06/12) and no number legible. Enwiki: MRZ on the back, 'valid for up to 10 years', applicants under 18 come with a parent (issued to children). The 13-digit number also appears in the Afghan passport. Paper tazkira still exists.

name: Canadian passport / Passeport canadien
mrz_optional: empty (filler) in specimen
notes: 2023-design specimen (IRCC sample, MARTIN SARAH): number P123456AA = 1 letter + 6 digits + 2 letters; issued 14 JAN/JAN 2023, expires 14 JAN/JAN 2033 (same day). Pre-2023 books (still valid until ~2033) use 2 letters + 6 digits (@{2}#{6}, Purview, Trellix, Cisco Cloudlock); an unofficial post also reports the 2023 switch to A123456BC. Adults 16+ choose 5 or 10 years; under 16: 5 years. [merge 2026-11-04] 16+ may also choose a 5-year passport.

name: None (no national identity card; citizenship cards discontinued 2012; provincial photo IDs / driver's licences out of scope)
notes: Canada issues no national ID card or passport card.

name: Biometric passport for travel abroad / Xorijga chiqish biometrik pasporti, Republic of Uzbekistan
mrz_optional: PINFL (14 digits) per kun.uz ('in a passport it appears in the bottom line, lower-right corner')
notes: Two-letter series + 7-digit number ('AA 1234567') from a developer package and kun.uz describing the old passport series/number; placeholder only, real series letters not documented. Since 2021 ID cards replace the domestic use of the biometric passport; the passport is for travel only. Old 2011-model biometric passports invalid from 1 Jan 2030. Validity not found.

name: ID card / Identifikatsiya ID-kartasi (Shaxsiy guvohnoma), Republic of Uzbekistan
mrz_optional: probably PINFL (14 digits, printed on the back) - not confirmed
notes: Series + number shape 'AA 1234567' only from a developer package (placeholder). 14-digit PINFL (personal identification number) printed on the back of the card. Issued from birth since 2021 (2 years under 1, 5 years 1-16, 10 years over 16 per kun.uz). Valid only inside Uzbekistan. MRZ presence not confirmed by a specimen.

name: Passport (Paszport)
notes: 2 letters (series) + 7 digits; the FIRST digit (3rd character) is a check digit over series+remaining 6 digits (weights 7,3,1, A=10..Z=35; whole 9-char number sums to 0 mod 10) per romek.info; BM series 1997-2001 had no check digit; AA.. series from 2001 model; EA series = biometric with fingerprints from 28 June 2009 (later series E*, e.g. EH). Purview "two letters + seven digits" agrees. Validity: 5 years if under 12 at issue, 10 years from 12 (gov.pl consular page, 2022 law); older secondary sources say 13 (pre-2022 rule). Temporary passport max 365 days. No specimen data page found (img/PL-pp.jpg from the first run is empty), so expiry_rule unknown.

name: Identity card (Dowód osobisty)
number_example: ABA300000 (sample number used in Polish Wikipedia's check-digit example)
validity_source: https://pl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dowód_osobisty_w_Polsce (citing ustawa o dowodach osobistych, Dz.U. 2025 poz. 1753) ; https://www.gov.pl/gov/uzyskaj-dowod-osobisty-dla-dziecka-lub-podopiecznego
mrz_optional: personal number = PESEL (11 digits) since series C (1 March 2015)
notes: 3 letters (series) + 6 digits; the FIRST digit (4th character) is the ICAO 9303 check digit over the other 8 characters (weights 7,3,1). Letters O and Q not used in the series (romek.info). Series sequence: A.. (2001), AXI from Nov 2013, CAA from March 2015, DAA from March 2019 (e-dowód), DEA from Nov 2021 (current ICAO/EU-2019/1157 model); so a new card should have series starting D or later. Card also carries a 6-digit CAN. Validity: 5 years under 12, 10 years from 12 (2021 amendment; before that under 5 -> 5 years), 12 months if fingerprints temporarily impossible. Pre-2015 cards issued to 65+ were indefinite and remain valid. Compulsory from 18 for residents, obtainable from birth. Purview "three letters + six digits, checksum" agrees.

name: Passeport biométrique / جواز السفر البيومتري (Royaume du Maroc)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen data page or issuer statement of the number format found (en-wiki article has no data page; none on Commons). Biometric passport since Dec 2008 pilot, compulsory from 1 April 2015 (bladi.net). Decree on the biometric passport: max validity 5 years, not extendable; 3 years for a child under 3 (Yabiladi on draft decree 2-08-310). A new-generation passport decree (2.26.551) adopted 2026 (Le Matin) - technical details pending; 10-year validity requested by MRE but not adopted.

name: Carte nationale d'identité électronique (CNIE) / البطاقة الوطنية للتعريف الإلكترونية
mrz_optional: CIN (national identity number), e.g. U1234567
notes: 2020 CNIE specimen: MRZ document number VSI99998 (check 5 verified), also printed top right of the back; the 'N°' printed front/back is the national identity number (CIN) U1234567, which goes in MRZ optional data. CIN = 1-2 letter region prefix (where first issued) + digits (en-wiki: region code + 6-digit serial; specimen shows U+7 digits), shape @{1,2}#{5,7} uncertain. Front also shows a 6-digit CAN. Law 04-20 (2020) on the CNIE: doc type 'I', state 'MAR'. Validity 10 years (en-wiki); compulsory from 16, obtainable at any age (minors optional) so min_age 16 is the compulsory age. Only one specimen: 3-letter+5-digit document-number shape not confirmed by a second source. 2008 CNIE (Thales) cards may still circulate; their layout not checked.

name: Angolan passport / Passaporte da República de Angola (type PN)
mrz_optional: unknown (blurred)
notes: Real document, shape only: number blurred, but MRZ line 2 shows '<' filler at position 9 and check digit at 10, so the number is 8 characters. OFAC/OpenSanctions lists an Angolan passport N####### (real document, shape only), consistent with 8 chars. Prefix letter N seen once only; other series letters possible. Document type code is PN (not P). Validity for minors unknown (only one adult specimen). Data page also shows marital status and BI number field.

name: Bilhete de Identidade de Cidadão Nacional (BI)
validity_source: https://lex.ao/docs/presidente-da-republica/2024/decreto-presidencial-n-o-267-24-de-28-de-novembro/ (citing Lei 3/21: 5 y if issued age 0-20, 10 y age 20-55, lifetime from 55)
notes: BI number = individual NIF (tax number) since Oct 2018 (Expansão, Ver Angola 2018); format 9 digits + 2 letters + 3 digits (14 chars) from tax-number references, example is a placeholder; letters presumably province code (LA = Luanda?), unconfirmed. Card number vs BI number distinction not found. New card since Nov 2017 has QR code and chip (Ver Angola); MRZ presence not confirmed (ID Analyzer claims MRZ parsing for Angola IDs). BI issued from birth since 2025 (biometricupdate 2025-11); age 1 from 2021. Compulsory. No specimen image found (Commons category absent).

name: Passport / جواز سفر (Jawaz Safar), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
notes: No specimen data page found (Commons has a cover only; web search found no format). Validity in Hijri (lunar) years per enwiki infobox: under 21 - 5 lunar years; 21 and over - 5 or 10 lunar years (applicant's choice). A generator using Gregorian dates should use 354-day lunar years (5 lunar ~ 4.85 solar). New e-passport (biometric chip, new data page) since 10 Feb 2022.

name: National Identity Card / بطاقة الهوية الوطنية (Bitaqat al-Hawiya al-Wataniya)
notes: Card/document number = the 10-digit national ID number (no separate card number found). Leading 1 = citizen (2 = resident Iqama, 3/4 border numbers); last digit is a Luhn (mod-10) check per validator libraries (Purview says 10 digits, no checksum). Example 1012345672 is a library test value, not a specimen. Compulsory for men 15/17+, women optional (enwiki). Validity reported as 10 Hijri years in third-party sources, not confirmed - left empty. No specimen found; MRZ presence unknown.

name: Pasaporte electrónico peruano (República del Perú)
mrz_optional: empty in specimen (DNI 8 digits printed on data page as National ID card No.)
notes: Migraciones specimen: number shown as placeholder PERU00000 (9 chars); issued 01/12/2015 expires 01/12/2025. 10-year validity for adults by Ley 31678 / DS 009-2023-IN (previously 5 years). Real number format not confirmed.

name: Documento Nacional de Identidad (DNI / DNIe), RENIEC
mrz_optional: none seen (line 1 after the number is filler)
notes: Real cards, shape only. The MRZ document-number field carries the CUI/DNI number (8 digits, lifelong; 1996+ national series) followed by filler and the ICAO check digit (old laminated card: I<PER + 8 digits + < + check). The card also prints a RENIEC check digit after the CUI ('xxxxxxxx-9', not part of the MRZ number) and a separate 'N° de Tarjeta' (card serial, ~8 chars, format not readable). 2020 card: issued 17 01 2020, expires 17 01 2028 (8 years, same day). Ley 32237 (2025) raised adult validity from 8 to 10 years; under 12: 3 years; 12-17 reported as 'until adulthood' (not a fixed term; 3 used as a guess only - see source), mandatory adult DNI at 17/18. Over-70 DNIs reportedly do not expire (es.wikipedia). Numbers issued 1984-1996 had a 2-digit department prefix (people born before Sep 1978). [merge 2026-11-04] 12-17 dropped from validity: 'until adulthood' is reported, no fixed term.

name: Malaysian passport / Pasport Malaysia
number_source: Purview sit-defn-malaysia-passport-number (A/H/K + 8 digits); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysian_passport (prefix by residency: A Peninsular Malaysia and Labuan, H Sabah, K Sarawak); sample data page A00000000: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Biodata_page_of_Malaysia_Passport.jpg ; real Sarawak passport K + 8 digits (shape only): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Malaysia_Passport_Samples.png
validity_source: https://www.nst.com.my/amp/news/nation/2026/06/1455177/malaysians-can-now-apply-10-year-passports-watch (10-year option from 3 Jun 2026 under Fees (Passports and Visas) (Amendment) Order 2026, RM350; 5-year RM200); real 2019 passport 15 MAR 2019 -> 15 MAR 2024
mrz_optional: 12-digit MyKad identity number (YYMMDDPBNNNG) without dashes
notes: Before June 2026 only 5-year passports (18+ may now choose 5 or 10; some outlets say 10-year only for ages 18-59: unresolved). Early renewals in mid-2026 added remaining validity on top of 10 years; Immigration stopped this in Aug 2026 (https://www.lowyat.net/2026/401295/immigration-halts-passports-over-10-years/), so expiry = issue + N years. New passport design from 1 Jul 2026 (number format change not checked). The data page prints the MyKad number ('No. Pengenalan'). The Commons 'Biodata page' sample has an odd 7-year span (31 AUG 2017 -> 31 AUG 2024) and is not an official specimen.

name: MyKad / Kad Pengenalan Malaysia
number_source: Purview sit-defn-malaysia-identification-card-number (YYMMDD + 2-digit place-of-birth code + 3 random digits + gender digit, odd male/even female); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malaysian_identity_card ; place-of-birth codes: https://www.jpn.gov.my/en/kod-negeri-eng
notes: Card number = 12-digit National Registration Identity Card Number (NRIC). Place-of-birth code 01-16 = Malaysian state, 21-59 states (extra codes), 60-99 = foreign country/region. Last digit gender parity. No expiry date printed; card first issued at 12 and must be replaced at 18. MyKid (under 12, optional) uses the same number. No MRZ.

name: Mozambican passport / Passaporte da República de Moçambique
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons has a cover only). Validity 5 years, non-renewable, per PRADO MOZ-AO-02001 as quoted in a search-engine snippet (PRADO itself not reachable; older model MOZ-AO-01001 also 5 years, renewable, allowed minors' endorsement). Current biometric passport (issued e.g. to Mozambicans in South Africa, citizenshiprightsafrica.org) validity and number format not confirmed; issuer SENAMI (Serviço Nacional de Migração).

name: Bilhete de Identidade (BI) - biometric identity card (DNIC)
notes: Compulsory from age 6, can be issued from birth (Wikipedia). Biometric BI introduced by Decreto 11/2008 (chip with fingerprints per Shufti). Card shows an 'Identification Number' and an expiry date (DNIC sends SMS a month before expiry) but neither the number format (commonly cited as 12 digits + 1 letter, unconfirmed) nor the validity periods were found. Commons has a BI image (File:Bilhete_de_identidade_(Mozambique).jpg) that could not be downloaded (Wikimedia 429 robot-policy blocks during survey) - re-check it.

name: Passport / Passeport (Republic of Ghana)
mrz_optional: empty
notes: Specimen data page of the 2010 ECOWAS biometric passport: H0000014, MRZ check digit 8 verified; issue 14 AUG 2009 -> expiry 14 AUG 2014 (5 years then, same_day). Validity raised from 5 to 10 years for applications from 31 March 2019 (en-wiki); a 5-year option still listed for minors on unofficial portal, not confirmed. Ghana began issuing a new chip-embedded polycarbonate-page passport in 2025 (gna.org.gh, pulse.com.gh); its number format not found. Leading letter meaning (H on specimen; G widely reported for ordinary passports) not confirmed by an issuer.

name: Ghana Card (national identity card, NIA)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Ghana Card (NIA chip card, current generation from 4 July 2011 per en-wiki, mass issue from 2017): MRZ on back (NIA via IRB ecoi 2135917; en-wiki). Card document-number shape not found. Personal ID Number (PIN) printed: GHA-#{9}-# (country code, 9 digits, check char; OECD TIN sheet says 8-9 digits and the check char may be a letter; official placeholder GHA-000000000-0); PIN = TIN for individuals. Registration from age 0; card issued on the spot to applicants 15+ (NIA via IRB); compulsory 16+ (en-wiki). Valid 10 years (NIA via IRB; en-wiki).

name: Passport of a citizen of Ukraine for travel abroad (Паспорт громадянина України для виїзду за кордон)
mrz_optional: Record No. (УНЗР, unique demographic register number) fills the optional data field; specimen shows placeholder 1234567890, real УНЗР is 13 digits (YYYYMMDD + 5 digits, written with a hyphen on the card)
notes: Specimen number XX000000 = 2 Latin letters + 6 digits (8 chars, MRZ padded with '<'). Purview "two letters or digits + six digits" agrees on length. Real series letters (e.g. F*, G*, E*) not verified. Specimen: issued 25 SEP 13, expires 25 SEP 23 -> same_day. Biometric (chip) passports since 1 January 2015; older non-biometric booklets (same 2+6 shape) may still circulate until expiry. Validity 4 years under 16, 10 years from 16.

name: Passport of the citizen of Ukraine, ID card form (Паспорт громадянина України, ID-картка)
validity_source: https://uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/Паспорт_громадянина_України (ID-card section; KMU resolution 302 of 25.03.2015, zakon.rada.gov.ua unreachable)
notes: Document No. = 9 digits, no series (State Migration Service: on the ID card only the number is indicated); Purview "ukraine-passport-domestic: nine digits" agrees, but no specimen with a filled number was found (Commons specimen is blank). Card also shows Record No. (УНЗР, 13 digits, YYYYMMDD-NNNNN, Unified State Demographic Register) and RNTRC (taxpayer number, 10 digits) on the back. MRZ is 3 x 30 (TD1) with four check digits (uk.wikipedia); optional-data content not seen (probably the УНЗР, unverified). Issued since 11 January 2016 (first-time applicants), to everyone from 1 October 2016; replaces the old internal passport booklet (series 2 Cyrillic letters + 6 digits, e.g. "СН 123456"), which remains valid. uk.wikipedia infobox says 4 years under 16 / 10 from 16 (conflicts with its own ID-card section 4 years 14-18 / 10 from 18; the latter used). Compulsory from 14.

name: Passport / جواز سفر, Republic of Yemen
notes: Only data page on Commons is a real document with every value blurred; number not readable. Document type printed 'PR' and MRZ starts 'PRYEM' (two-letter type code PR for the regular passport - a generator should emit PR, not P<). Data page also has a 2D barcode. Validity 6 years (enwiki infobox), no age split found. Non-biometric MRP.

name: Personal identity card / البطاقة الشخصية, Republic of Yemen (Civil Status and Civil Registration Authority)
notes: Enwiki policy list: Yemen 'has an identity card; unclear if it is mandatory'. No specimen, number format, validity or minimum age found (Commons search had nothing; the web-search budget ran out before a deeper search). Two authorities (Sanaa and Aden governments) have issued cards since 2015, so formats may differ by issuer.

name: Malagasy passport / Pasipaoro malagasy / Passeport malgache
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons: covers incl. 'Malagasy passport (1993-2000).jpg', 'Malagasy Passport Cover 2013.svg'). Validity 5 years per English Wikipedia infobox only (no issuer source found); child rule unknown. Number format unknown.

name: Kara-panondrom-pirenena (KP) / Carte nationale d'identité (CIN) de citoyen malagasy
notes: Compulsory from 18 (decree 78-277 of 3 Oct 1978, per Wikipedia); a guide says it is often issued from 16 for school/exams (https://guide.za-malagasy.com/en/demarches-et-documents-administratifs/comment-faire-une-carte-d-identite-nationale-cin-1.html). CIN number commonly described as 12 digits - NOT confirmed by any source found. Paper card; a MOSIP-based digital ID pilot started 2025-2026 (biometricupdate.com). Validity not found.

name: Passeport / Passport (République de Côte d'Ivoire; ECOWAS/CEDEAO passport)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No data-page specimen or issuer statement of the number format found: Commons has only the cover (File:Passeport_Ivoirien.png); en/fr-wiki give no number text; PRADO (CIV-AO-02001) not reachable. Biometric passport first issued 31 July 2008 (en-wiki), compulsory from 1 April 2010 (abidjan.net, secondary). Issued by the Sûreté nationale/DGPN; produced and personalised by SNEDAI (monpasseport.ci platform). Validity 5 years (fr-wiki, en-wiki infobox, afrique-sur7.fr); no minor-specific rule found.

name: Carte nationale d'identité (CNI) biométrique
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Law 2019-566: biometric multi-application chip CNI, compulsory from 16, may be issued from 5, valid 10 years from issue (art.4). Issued by ONECI from Oct 2019; 2009 cards expired end 2021 (le360). Card also carries the NNI (numéro national d'identification); NNI and card-number formats not found; MRZ presence not confirmed. Implementing decree 2019-945 not reachable.

name: Passport / राहदानी (Rahadani), Nepal (e-passport; MOFA Department of Passports)
mrz_optional: Personal No. field on the e-passport (citizenship or national ID number per enwiki field list); redacted on the Commons page
notes: E-passports since 17 Nov 2021. Commons e-passport (real document, shape only): number at top right starts with PA, rest redacted; issue 09 FEB 2022, expiry 08 FEB 2032 (10 years, day_before); issuing authority 'MOFA, DEPARTMENT OF PASSPORTS'. The 7-digit tail comes only from a third-party npm validator (example PA1234567, '2 letters + 6-8 digits') - length unconfirmed. Previous MRP (2010-2021, still in circulation until ~2031): 8 digits (real 2011 data page, MRZ number field 8 digits + filler '<' + check; issue 17 APR 2011, expiry 16 APR 2021, 'MOFA, CENTRAL PASSPORT OFFICE'; field 'Citizenship No'). Minors' validity not found (enwiki gives 10 years flat).

name: National Identity Card / राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र (Rastriya Parichaya Patra), Department of National ID and Civil Registration
notes: Blank official template on Commons (chip card; fields NIN, surname, given name, DOB, mother's and father's names, date of issue; no expiry field, no MRZ on the front; back not seen). NIN said to be 10 digits by one law-firm guide only (unconfirmed, left empty); do not confuse with the 16-digit application number. Lifetime validity (enwiki). Minimum age 16 assumed from citizenship-certificate eligibility (NID requires citizenship certificate, issued at 16) - not stated explicitly. Rollout from FY 2018/19. Citizenship certificate (nagarikta) number is a separate, district-based number with slashes/hyphens.

name: Passeport de la République du Cameroun / Cameroonian passport (CEMAC biometric)
notes: No data-page specimen or number format found (Commons has covers and the 2022 inner lexicon page only; no sanctions-list Cameroonian passport found; no Purview definition). Ordinary passport 5 y per two guides (service passport 10 y); ru.wikipedia infobox says 2 y for children under 14, 5 y adults (unsourced). Current booklet: CEMAC-model e-passport produced via Augentic/PassCam since July 2021; 2022 lexicon lists a CAN (card access number) field on the data page. mrz td3 assumed from ICAO e-passport (not seen).

name: Carte nationale d'identité (CNI) / National Identity Card
validity_source: https://infospratiques.cm/cni-cameroun/ (new biometric CNI valid 10 years; older sources say 5 y for the pre-2025 card)
notes: New chip CNI issued since 3 March 2025 under Décret 2025/059 of 28 Feb 2025 (features and issuance of identity documents; replaces the 2016 CNI decree); produced by Augentic, pre-enrolment at idcam.cm. Law 90/042 institutes the CNI. Card number / NIN format not found; the decree PDF on prc.cm is a degraded scan that could not be read past page 1. Compulsory age: Digital Business Africa cites 15 (older card), unverified. Optional per Wikipedia list but required for voting, passports, driving licences.
