name: Pasaporte venezolano (República Bolivariana de Venezuela, Mercosur model since 2015)
notes: No data-page specimen found (Commons has covers and visa-stamp pages only; SAIME publishes no format). A single third-party document (2025 certification) shows a 9-digit all-numeric number - hint only, not used. Validity per es.wikipedia: under 3: 3 y, 3-17: 5 y, 18+: 10 y; provisional passport 1 y. SAIME also stamped 'prórrogas' extending expired passports (2017-2023).

name: Cédula de identidad (Venezuela), SAIME
notes: Real card, shape only: 'V' (venezolano; 'E' for foreigners) + cédula number printed with dots (8 digits, e.g. V xx.xxx.215); the number is lifelong and sequential, older holders have 7 or fewer digits. Laminated card without MRZ. Expiry printed as month-year only (issued 12-06-04, vence 06-2014 = 10 years). First issuance from age 9; foreigners: transeúnte 1 y, residente 5 y. Card also shows issuing-office code/serial (e.g. 'MM206') - meaning not documented.

name: Australian passport
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Australian_R_series_biodata_page_2022.jpg (DFAT R-series sample 'Jane Citizen': RA0123456); Purview sit-defn-australia-passport-number (letter N/E/D/F/A/C/U/X + 7 digits, or PA/PB/PC/PD/PE/PF/PU/PW/PX/PZ + 7 digits)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Australian_passport (Australian Passports Act 2005 / Determination: 10 years for adults 16+, 5 years under 16; adults 75+ may choose 5 or 10); specimen 01 AUG 2022 -> 01 AUG 2032
mrz_optional: specimen: '<99999000T' (meaning unknown)
notes: Sample digits are sequential (0123456), shape only. Series letters: R series from 2022 (RA...), P series 2014-2022 (PA..PZ + 7 digits), N/E/D/F/A/C/U/X + 7 digits on older books (Purview). Purview lacks the R prefix, so it is out of date. Older P-series passports remain valid until ~2032.

number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_identity_card_policies_by_country (Australia: no national identity card; Australia Card 1985 and Access Card 2007 proposals failed)
notes: Identification relies on passports, state/territory driver licences and photo cards, Medicare cards.

name: Passeport électronique AES / Passport (République du Niger, Confédération des États du Sahel); previously ECOWAS passport
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen or issuer statement of the number format found (en-wiki article has only field list; Commons: no data page). New AES e-passport (ordinary and service) instituted by decree adopted in Council of Ministers 26 Dec 2025; enrolment launched 16 July 2026 (apanews; biometricupdate 2026-07-20); vendor Al Itissal Al Jadeed (Libya); five categories (ordinary, service, diplomatic, refugee, hajj). Validity of the AES passport in Niger not found; Burkina's AES ordinary passport is 5 years (burkina24) - likely common, unconfirmed. Earlier ECOWAS biometric passports remain in circulation; their number format and validity not found.

name: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique AES (CNIB-AES) / Carte d'identité biométrique AES
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: New polycarbonate CNIB-AES instituted by decree 2025-738/PCNSP/MI/SP/AT of 26 Dec 2025; launched 27 March 2026 (president enrolled first); valid 5 years; available from 15, under-15s with parental authorisation; fee 4,500 FCFA (beninwebtv 2026-03-29; osiris.sn). Card number, NIN and MRZ details not found. Older Nigerien CNI (non-biometric) still circulating; format not found. Note Burkina's CIB-AES has different rules (10 years, from 5) - the AES card is not uniform across members.

name: North Korean passport / 조선민주주의인민공화국 려권
number_source: Only a real public-affairs (PA) passport data page with the number field blank/redacted: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:North_Korean_Passport_First_Page.png ; no Purview definition; no format source found
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Korean_passport (infobox: 5 years; data page lists 'length of the passport validity (five years)')
notes: Machine-readable/biometric passports exist (MRZ visible on the PA passport page: 'PAPRK...'). Ordinary passports are rarely issued to private citizens; most passports seen abroad are public-affairs (PA), official or diplomatic types. Expiry printed YY-MM-DD per Wikipedia. Number format unknown.

name: Citizen's identity card / 공민증 (Pyongyang residents: 평양시민증)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:North_korean_identity_document_002.jpg (real card, shape only: '번호' (number) = county name in Hangul (e.g. 온성, Onsong county) + digits, partly redacted)
notes: Real document, shape only. Paper booklet-style card with no MRZ and no expiry date; the number starts with a Hangul county name followed by digits (count not visible: at least 2 digits '15' then redacted). Dates written in the Juche calendar (주체 + year), e.g. issue 'Juche 99.' (= 2010). Also shows blood type (피형). No reliable number pattern can be derived.

name: Passport / جواز سفر, Syrian Arab Republic (Ministry of Interior, Immigration and Passports Department)
mrz_optional: personal (national) number listed among data-page fields (Keesing via IRB 2013); MRZ position not seen
notes: Only data page on Commons is a real MRP (real document, shape only, mostly blacked out): passport number printed on the facing page starts 'N 0' (rest redacted, length unknown); a separate 'Issue no./N delivrance' field starts '004' then a letter (L); MRZ starts 'PNSYR' - document type code PN (enwiki: PN ordinary, PD diplomatic, PS service, PL special), so a generator should emit PN, not P<. Biometric e-passport since 2023 (PRADO SYR-AO-01004 per search snippet, max validity 6 years); 2025 post-Assad cover redesign (green, new eagle) on Commons, data page not seen. Validity 6 years (Keesing); men who have not done military service get 6-month or 2-year passports; one-time 10-year extension from 2013 (SANA). Father's and mother's names on the bio page. Old 1980s handwritten books used series letters (e.g. 'SR/77').

name: National Identity Card / البطاقة الشخصية (بطاقة الهوية الوطنية), Syrian Arab Republic
notes: No specimen found (Commons has none; PRADO not reachable). Card is a laminated paper card in Arabic only, no MRZ; no expiry date (Canadian IRB 2007 via Refworld); compulsory from 14 (PRADO snippet via search; idcards row says 14). National number (الرقم الوطني) introduced with the 2010 civil-registry overhaul and printed on the card and passport; length commonly given as 11 digits but no source found - left empty. A new card edition is reported as planned for 2026 (vendor).

name: Passeport AES / Passport (Burkina Faso, Confédération des États du Sahel)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen data page or issuer statement of the number format found: Commons files are covers (File:Passeport_Burkina_Faso_(version_2025).png AES cover; File:BurkinaFaso_passport_001.jpg ECOWAS cover; File:BurkinaFaso_passport_002.jpg not downloadable - rate limited); PRADO BFA-AO-03001/04001 not reachable. History (en-wiki): ECOWAS biometric passport first issued 21 Aug 2013; passport without ECOWAS logo Sept 2024 (Emptech, China); AES passport in circulation from 29 Jan 2025 (ONI communiqué via burkina24), exclusively AES from Aug 2025; green ordinary / blue service / red diplomatic; ICAO-compliant; 34 pages, valid 5 years (burkina24). Old passports valid until expiry. No minor-specific rule found.

name: Carte d'identité biométrique AES (CIB-AES); previously Carte nationale d'identité burkinabè (CNIB) / carte d'identité CEDEAO
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: CIB-AES launched 1 Dec 2025 (President received the first card), mass production from Jan 2026; produced by ONI, polycarbonate; available from age 5, compulsory from 13, valid 10 years, 3,500 FCFA; temporary ID card for those lacking documents (Sidwaya via allafrica 2026-01-05). Earlier: law 009-2017/AN instituted the biometric multi-application chip ECOWAS ID card, compulsory from 15, obtainable from 5, valid 10 years from issue (art.4-5); the 2001 CNIB (law 005-2001) stayed valid for a 5-year transition. Old CNIBs still circulate (11.3 million records in 2020). Card number, NIP/NIN and MRZ formats not found for either card.

name: Republic of China (Taiwan) passport / 中華民國護照
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Republic_of_China_Passport_Data_Page.jpg (MOFA specimen, 2017 design: 888800371); Purview sit-defn-taiwan-passport-number (9 digits; biometric passports '3' + 8 digits)
validity_source: https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-56-3094-d9075-1.html (BOCA: under 14 five years, otherwise ten years; males of conscription age limited); specimen 25 DEC 2017 -> 25 DEC 2027
mrz_optional: national identification number (letter + 9 digits, e.g. A234567893)
notes: Specimen number 8888... is a specimen series; real biometric passports (since Dec 2008) reportedly start with 3 (Purview); use 3#{8} for realistic output. Men of conscription age (and conscripts) in Taiwan get 5 years (3 years if issued abroad or as a lost-passport replacement), per BOCA rule change on Enforcement Rules art. 24. Data page also prints the national ID number. New 2021 cover design did not change the number format as far as found.

name: National Identification Card / 中華民國國民身分證
number_source: Purview sit-defn-taiwan-national-identification-number (letter + 1|2 + 8 digits); https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/中華民國國民身分證 (letter = household registration county, 1 male / 2 female, last digit check)
notes: Card number = 10-character unified ID number (統一編號). First letter is the county/city of first household registration, mapped to a 2-digit value for the weighted check digit. 2nd digit 1=male, 2=female (8/9 are used by the new-format resident certificate numbers for foreigners since 2021). Card has no expiry. Compulsory at 14, may be applied for from birth. Planned eID (New ID) suspended. No MRZ.

name: Passeport biométrique sécurisé e-Passeport AES (République du Mali, Confédération des États du Sahel); previously ECOWAS passport
mrz_optional: unknown (NINA printed on passports since April 2016 per CTDEC)
notes: No specimen or issuer statement of the number format found (Commons: no Malian data page). AES passport launched 29 Jan 2025; Mali's e-Passeport AES production officially (re)started 27 Oct 2025 (osiris.sn, digitalbusiness.africa): polycarbonate data page, chip with fingerprints and photo, ICAO; supplier Emptech (biometricupdate 2025-10). Validity 5 years from en-wiki infobox (pre-AES ECOWAS passport); AES validity in Mali not stated (Burkina AES ordinary passport is 5 years). Old ECOWAS passports valid until expiry. CTDEC (via IRB ecoi 2021556): since April 2016 the NINA appears on new passports.

name: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique sécurisée (CEDEAO standard); formerly carte NINA
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Decree 2022-0639/PT-RM of 3 Nov 2022: biometric secure national ID card to ECOWAS standards, compulsory from 15, valid 5 years; first issue free; replaces the NINA card, the old CNI and consular card (digitalbusiness.africa/osiris.sn). Handover started April 2023 after NINA data update (9 Jan-31 Mar 2023; allafrica 2023-04-11). NINA = Numéro d'identification nationale (law 06-040 of 2006), unique per person; the NINA card (2013) carried NINA, a service number and a PDF417 barcode (IRB ecoi 2021556); NINA shape not found. Card number format and MRZ presence not found. An AES biometric ID card may supersede it (Burkina launched CIB-AES Dec 2025); Malian status unknown.

name: Passport / ගුවන් ගමන් බලපත්‍රය / கடவுச்சீட்டு, Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen or official number format found (commonly reported as N + 7 digits for older books - unverified, left empty). Under 16: 3 years normally, 10 years on parents' written request (Dept. of Immigration and Emigration). Biometric (e-)passport from 2025 per enwiki.

name: National Identity Card (NIC) / ජාතික හැඳුනුම්පත / தேசிய அடையாள அட்டை
notes: Card number = NIC number. New format (from 1 Jan 2016): 12 digits YYYY + DDD (day of year, +500 for females) + 4-digit serial + check digit (algorithm unpublished). Old format still valid for life: #{9}[VX] = YY + DDD + 3 serial + check + V (voter) / X. Example 197419202757 from enwiki (shape). No MRZ on the NIC; no expiry. Eligibility 16 per enwiki (Registration of Persons law; some sources say 15).

name: Malawian passport (e-passport since Jan 2019)
notes: Issuer: ordinary passport 10 years; child passport 5 years, issued to children under 10. A 2025 news item (maraviexpress, now offline) reported the ordinary passport lifespan cut from 10 to 5 years with a fee reduction - unconfirmed, issuer page still says 10. First e-passports printed 14 Jan 2019 (nyasatimes). Number format unknown (no specimen found). td3 assumed.

name: National Identification Card / Chiphaso cha Nzika (NRB)
notes: Compulsory for citizens 16+ (NRB). NRB says the card has a unique identification number, QR code and a Machine-Readable Zone (search snippet; MRZ type not seen - likely td1). Number format not found (often cited as 8 alphanumeric, unconfirmed). Original cards (from 2017) carried expiry dates that varied with holder age; expiries suspended then, in Sept 2026, the expiry policy was dropped (validity 0 = no expiry going forward).

name: Passport / Паспорт гражданина Республики Казахстан / Қазақстан Республикасы азаматының паспорты
mrz_optional: 12-digit IIN (ЖСН / ID No.) probably - redacted on the Commons page; IIN shown on page 2
notes: MVD order No. 533 (2023) on document samples: passport number of nine alphanumeric characters 'one letter and an eight-digit number', on every page and the covers. The letter is N on the real 2009 data page (visible first character; rest redacted; real document, shape only) - pattern uses N; other letters possible but none seen. Real page: issue 02.12.2009, expiry 01.12.2019 (10 years, day_before). gov.kz: 5 years for children under 12, 10 years from 12. IIN: 12 digits YYMMDD + century/sex digit + 4-digit serial + check digit (egov.kz; check rule mod 11 weights). Biometric passports since 24 Dec 2008/2009.

name: Identity card / Удостоверение личности гражданина Республики Казахстан / Жеке куәлік
mrz_optional: 12-digit IIN (line 1 after the document number: IDKAZ + 9 + check + 12 + <<< fits exactly; redacted on the sample)
notes: MVD order No. 533 (2023): ID card number 'of nine numeric characters', printed at the top of the reverse. Commons card (Dec 2014 design, personal data blanked) shows number 000000009 (looks like a sample/low serial), issue 11.10.2015, expiry 11.10.2025 - same day (no day subtracted, unlike the passport). Validity 10 years, issued from 16 (ruwiki). IIN on the front (ЖСН/ИИН): 12 digits, see passport row. Previous chip card 2008-2014 still seen until expiry.

name: Pasaporte chileno (República de Chile, electrónico)
mrz_optional: RUN (Rol Único Nacional, 7-8 digits + check digit 0-9/K)
notes: Registro Civil resolution (Diario Oficial 7 Dec 2024): passport number 9 alphanumeric characters, laser-perforated on visa pages; MRZ lower line carries passport number and RUN. Exact letter/digit layout not found (no specimen data page found; Commons API rate-limited); the 2024 cédula uses 2 letters + 7 digits, so the passport may use a similar scheme (unverified). Before 2013 the passport number equalled the RUN; 2013-2024 a separate document-number series. New model since 16 Dec 2024; old-format passports stay valid until expiry. Validity 10 years since 2020 (chileatiende gives 10 years; es.wikipedia mentions 5 years for minors, not confirmed by issuer).

name: Cédula de identidad (Chile), electrónica
mrz_optional: line 1: issuing office/consulate code; line 2: RUN
notes: Res. 466 exenta/2024 (Registro Civil): MRZ doc code 'IN', document number 9 alphanumeric chars; line 1 optional = office code, line 2 optional = RUN. 2024 specimen shows 'BA3.011.075' (printed with dots) = 2 letters + 7 digits; issued 16 MAYO 2024, expires 07 MAR 2030 (= holder's birthday; not explained by the 10-year rule, illustrative). 2013-2024 cards: 9-digit document number (specimen 100000001, issued 1 SEP 2013, expires 10 AGO 2023); pre-2013 cards used the RUN as card number. RUN = 7-8 digits + mod-11 check (0-9 or K), e.g. 12.749.625-K (Purview pattern agrees). Validity 10 years at all ages; 20 years (domestic use only) for 80+ or 60+ with severe dependency (Ley 21.767, 2025); online renewal of an expired card gives 3 years. Can be issued from birth; compulsory at 18.

name: Zambian passport
notes: Passports Act No. 22 of 2003 s.5(4): valid 10 years from issue; a passport for a child below 10 is valid 5 years (zambialaws lists it under a 'repealed acts 2003' heading - whether a later Act replaced it was not checked; embassy pages also give 10 years for adults; some secondary sources say child cutoff 16). Number format unknown (no specimen found; 'ZN' prefix rumoured, unconfirmed). td3 assumed (machine-readable passport).

name: National Registration Card (NRC)
notes: NRC number = 6-digit serial issued sequentially within a district / 2-digit place-of-issue code (first digit province, second district, e.g. 11 Lusaka, 61 Ndola, 82 Mongu) / nationality digit 1 Zambian, 2 Commonwealth, 3 other foreigner (card colour green/blue/pink). Example is Kaunda's historic first card (public record). Compulsory from 16, laminated paper card, must be carried (Wikipedia). No expiry date known (validity 0 is an inference from the laminated card design; unconfirmed). MRZ none: laminated card, no MRZ described. A biometric/integrated NRC (INRIS) has been piloted; not covered.

name: Somali passport / Baasaboorka Soomaaliyeed / جواز السفر الصومالي
notes: Validity 5 years, not renewable (Somali Wikipedia: '5 sano ... La bedeli maayo'); no issuer page found. Number format unknown: Commons has 'Passport of the Federal Republic of Somalia.png' (cover) and 1988 passport scans; no current data page. From 1 Sept 2025 a NIRA national ID is required to apply. Somaliland issues its own passport (not ISO-recognised; Commons 'Somaliland Passport Data Page.jpg' exists but could not be downloaded - out of scope anyway). td3 assumed (biometric e-passport).

name: National ID card / Kaarka Aqoonsiga Qaranka (NIRA); earlier Warqadda Aqoonsiga
notes: NIRA (est. March 2023, Identification and Registration Act 2023; launch Sept 2023) issues a lifelong unique 11-digit National ID number (#{11}, issuer: nira.gov.so) on an ID certificate, digital mobile ID or physical card; a separate card/document number, validity and MRZ were not found (NIRA mentions renewing expired cards, so cards do expire). Now required for passports (Sept 2025) and domestic travel (2026). Minimum age not stated. Commons 'SSC-Khatumo identity card.png' is a regional (non-federal) card.

name: Passeport tchadien / جواز سفر تشادي / Chadian passport
validity_source: https://fr.wikipedia.org/wiki/Passeport_tchadien (valable cinq ans à compter de la date de sa délivrance)
notes: No data-page specimen, number format or sanctions-list number found; no Purview definition. Issued by ANATS (Agence nationale des titres sécurisés) which also assigns the NNI. CEMAC-model e-passport cover (chip logo) on Commons. 2017 ecoi/IRB report: diplomatic/service passports 5 y; ordinary not biometric at the time. Data page labels in French and Arabic; 32 pages. mrz td3 assumed (not seen).

name: Carte nationale d'identité (CNI) / بطاقة الهوية الوطنية
validity_source: https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/1443867.html (IZF 2017, Keesing: valid ten years; pre-ANATS card)
notes: Biometric CNI issued by ANATS; every holder has an NNI (numéro national d'identification) recorded in the biometric registry (tchadinfos, alwihdainfo), but its length/format was not found. Card number vs NNI unknown. Validity 10 y is from 2017 sources for the older police-issued card; current ANATS card validity unconfirmed. Compulsory (Wikipedia list). Fee 10,000 FCFA, free periods announced 2023-2025.

name: Passport (Pașaport simplu electronic)
mrz_optional: CNP (personal numeric code, 13 digits) in the optional data field
notes: Specimen number 9 digits starting 0 (040021039); document type printed "PE" (electronic passport), MRZ starts "PE". Specimen issued 02 SEP 24, expires 02 SEP 34 -> same_day. Purview "eight or nine digits": 8-digit numbers may belong to older series (not verified). Validity: 3 years under 12, 5 years 12-17, 10 years 18+; temporary passport 1 year. CNP = 13 digits (sex/century digit + YYMMDD + 2-digit county + 3-digit serial + check digit). 2024 model introduced 2024; previous 2009/2019 models still circulate.

name: Electronic identity card (Carte electronică de identitate, CEI); also simple identity card (Carte de identitate simplă, CIS)
number_example: SP1234694 (2021 pilot specimen); SP1236343 (2025 specimen on carteadeidentitate.gov.ro)
notes: Both specimens show "Nr. document" = 2 letters + 7 digits with letters "SP" (possibly a specimen-only series; real series letters not verified). CEI piloted in Cluj 2021, general issue from 20 March 2025, issued from birth. Validity per press (euronews.ro, citing MAI): 2 years under 2, 4 years 2-14, 5 years 14-18, 10 years 18+, unlimited from 70. Pre-2025 CI (ID-2 card, compulsory from 14): series = 2 letters (usually county code, e.g. RX, RT) + 6-digit number, TD2-like 2-line MRZ; validity 4 years 14-17, 7 years 18-24, 10 years 25-54, indefinite from 55 (en.wikipedia Romanian identity card); still in circulation. CNP 13 digits printed on card (personal number). TD1 MRZ per EU Reg. 2019/1157; optional-data content not seen (back of card not read).

name: Passeport / Passport (République du Sénégal; ECOWAS/CEDEAO passport)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No data-page specimen or issuer statement of the number format found: Commons has covers only (File:Senegalese_Passport_2025.jpg, File:Senegalese_Passport.png); en/fr-wiki have no number text; PRADO not reachable. Issued by the Direction de l'Automatisation des Fichiers (DAF, Ministry of Interior); biometric e-passport (ICAO 9303, chip) since about 2007 (en-wiki). Validity 5 years per en-wiki infobox; senego.com (2026, secondary) says 'validité dépend du format choisi (10 ans pour les majeurs en règle générale)' - conflict, not confirmed by DAF. Search snippet of PRADO SEN-AD-05001 (diplomatic, first issued 1 Nov 2020): polycarbonate data card, max 5 years - suggests a 2020 generation with polycarbonate data page; ordinary equivalent not checked.

name: Carte d'identité biométrique CEDEAO (carte nationale d'identité)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: ECOWAS biometric ID card (common ECOWAS design, also a travel document within ECOWAS). Law 2016-09 of 14 March 2016: art.2 compulsory from 15, may be issued from 5; art.3 valid 10 years. Decree 2016-1536 lists the NIN among the card mentions; NIN and card-number formats not found here. A 2026 bill (21/2026) amending the 2016 law was before parliament in Sept 2026 (senego.com), outcome unknown.

name: Pasaporte ecuatoriano (República del Ecuador, electrónico since Sep 2020)
mrz_optional: cédula number (10 digits) per El Universo
notes: El Universo (2023): the e-passport number is now an alphanumeric 'book number', no longer the cédula number; the personal-number field carries the cédula (NUI). Exact layout not found (no specimen data page located). Old machine-readable passports (pre-2020) used the 10-digit cédula as passport number and remain valid until expiry. Validity 10 years after the Ley de Movilidad Humana reform (earlier e-passports: 6 years per El Universo).

name: Cédula de identidad (Ecuador), electrónica since 2020/2021
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Sample card (Registro Civil promo image, as used on es.wikipedia): 'No. DOCUMENTO 1375.19.239' (9 digits printed with dots) is the card number, distinct from the NUI 1719142905 (10 digits; first 2 = province 01-24, 30 for abroad; last digit mod-10 check; Purview agrees: 01-30/90/99 + 8 digits). Back side/MRZ not seen, so whether the MRZ number field holds the 9-digit card number or the NUI is unconfirmed. Front shows expiry only (23 MAR 2030). Issued from birth; compulsory 18+. Older laminated cédulas used the NUI as the only number.

name: Dutch passport (Nederlands paspoort)
mrz_optional: empty since model 2021 (BSN removed from MRZ and chip; before: BSN, 9 digits, in personal-number field)
notes: RvIG: 'positie 1 en 2: letters, positie 3 t/m 8: letters of cijfers en positie 9: een cijfer. De letter O en het cijfer 0 komen in het documentnummer niet voor.' Letter O never used; digit 0 not used in documents issued since 1 Dec 2019 (older documents may contain 0, i.e. [A-NP-Z0-9] in positions 3-9). Same number series/format as the ID card. Model 2021 introduced 30 Aug 2021; BSN (burgerservicenummer, 9 digits, 11-proof) now only printed on the back of the data page and in a QR code. Validity: max 10 years, under 18 max 5 years (since 9 Mar 2014). python-stdnum nl.identiteitskaartnummer agrees (hint). Example not taken: Commons specimen not reachable (HTTP 429). Purview 'nine letters or digits' is looser.

name: Dutch identity card (Nederlandse identiteitskaart)
mrz_optional: empty since model 2021 (BSN removed from MRZ and chip)
notes: Same structure as the passport (RvIG brochure ID card model 2021: positions 1-2 letters, 3-8 letters or digits, 9 a digit; no letter O, no digit 0 - 0 only on documents issued before 1 Dec 2019). Model 2021 (from 2 Aug 2021, Reg. 2019/1157 TD1). BSN printed on the back and in a QR code only. Max 10 years, under 18 max 5 years. Issued at any age (no minimum); obligation to show ID from age 14 (Wet op de identificatieplicht; not re-checked here). Valid for travel within EU/Schengen.

name: Pasaporte guatemalteco (República de Guatemala, IGM)
notes: IGM communiqué (La Hora, 23 May 2024): the passport number is 15 digits = 6 digits (age-of-majority flag, department, municipality) + the first 9 digits of the holder's CUI (8-digit serial + check digit); codes unified on 20 Jul 2023, printed separated again from 21 Mar 2024; machine-readable reading uses the last 9 digits of the unified code (so the MRZ document-number field likely holds 9 digits = CUI serial+check - inferred, no specimen seen). Exact order of the 6-digit block not confirmed. Adults choose 5 or 10 years (fees for both); minors 5 years (en.wikipedia).

name: Documento Personal de Identificación (DPI), RENAP
notes: Card/serial number format unknown (no specimen found). Personal number = CUI, 13 digits, lifelong (Decreto 39-2010 reforming Ley RENAP 90-2005): 8 assigned digits + 1 check digit + 2-digit department of birth + 2-digit municipality of birth; usually written '#### ##### ####' (pattern #{8}#{1}#{2}#{2}; issuer). The card back carries a 'Número de serie del documento'. Validity 10 years (art. 63), indefinite from age 70 (art. 64). Compulsory 18+; a minors' DPI (DPIME, 0-17) was suspended 2014 and relaunched (RENAP 2026 security sheet lists a correlative document number, serial number and an MRZ).

name: Cambodian passport / លិខិតឆ្លងដែន (Passeport du Royaume du Cambodge)
number_source: No specimen data page found: Commons has only covers (File:Cambodia's Biometric Passport.png, File:Cambodia Biometric Passport.png); no Purview definition; English Wikipedia gives no number format

number_source: No specimen or format source found: Commons search for a Cambodian identity card returned nothing; no Purview definition; no English Wikipedia article

name: Zimbabwean passport (e-passport since 2022)
notes: Wikipedia infobox: adult 10 years, child 5 years (child age cutoff not stated, so validity left empty; children 16+ must first obtain a national ID card, zimankara.org.tr). Older passports printed issuing-state code 'ZIM' instead of ISO 'ZWE' (Wikipedia) - relevant for MRZ of older books. E-passport with polycarbonate data page rolled out from 2022 (heraldonline). Number format unknown (no specimen found). td3 assumed.

name: National Registration Card / national identity card (Registrar General)
notes: Number layout: 2-digit district-of-registration code (e.g. 63 Harare, 08 Bulawayo, 03 Mberengwa, 21 Insiza; bulawayo24), hyphen, 6 or 7-digit serial, 1 check letter, 2-digit district of origin (00 for foreigners/'aliens', Wikipedia example shape '12 345678 A00'); separators vary (hyphen/space). 6-vs-7 digit serial and check-letter algorithm come only from developer libraries (localregex, zim-validate) - hints. Compulsory at 16 (Wikipedia). Metal and plastic card generations; no MRZ known; validity not found (traditionally no expiry). Number printed on passports/driving licences too.

name: South Sudanese passport (electronic)
notes: E-passports issued since 3 Jan 2012 (Wikipedia en/es). Validity 5 years from Russian Wikipedia infobox only (English infobox empty) - weak. Issuance suspended Aug 2024 after printing-software failure (CNPI; radiotamazuj). Number format unknown; Commons has covers only ('South Sudanese passport.jpg', 'Паспорт гражданина Южного Судана.png'). td3 assumed.

name: National Identity Card (South Sudan; Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration)
notes: Issued to every South Sudanese aged 18+ (Wikipedia list of identity card policies); a separate Nationality Certificate is also issued. Launched with passports in Jan 2012. No number format, validity or specimen found (web search budget ran out before a dedicated search).

name: Passeport biométrique / Passport (République de Guinée; ECOWAS passport)
validity_source: https://guineenews.org/2021/01/15/guinee-lemission-des-passeports-de-dix-ans-de-validite-a-deja-debute-source/ ; Canadian IRB response citing PRADO (5 years)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No specimen data page or issuer statement of the number format found (no Commons data page; en-wiki: no number text; PRADO GIN-AO-03001 not reachable). Validity: Guinéenews Jan 2021 citing a Ministry of Security source: new 10-year passports (1,000,000 GNF) issued alongside the 5-year option (500,000 GNF), applicant's choice; en-wiki infobox '5 years'. No minor-specific rule found. Enrolment/issuance extended to all administrative regions from 16 June 2025 (guineenews). [merge 2026-11-04] First issued 2014-05-14 (IRB). A 10-year option is reported from 2021 (guineenews); validity 5 per IRB.

name: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique (CNI)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Biometric CNI issuance (re)started early 2021; project head (Guinéenews 2021-02-03): 100,000 GNF, valid 5 years, printed centrally. Since March 2025 the first CNI is free for citizens aged 16+ (decree; guineenews 2025-03-27); under-16s may apply at the old fee, so min_age 16 is the free/standard age, not a hard minimum. Card number, NIN and MRZ details not found; no specimen on Commons.

name: Rwandan passport / Pasiporo / Passeport rwandais (East African Community e-passport)
notes: Issuer (Rwandan embassy page): child (under 16) passport valid 2 or 5 years; adult (16+) 5 or 10 years at the applicant's choice (75,000 vs 100,000 FRW) - validity field shows the longest option. Children under 16 give no biometrics. Older passports issued up to 27 June 2019 were valid until 28 June 2022 (EAC e-passport from June 2019). Number format unknown (Commons has only covers: 'Rwanda passport obverse 001.jpg', 'Rwandan Passport.webp'). td3 assumed.

name: Indangamuntu / Rwandan National Identity Card (NIDA)
notes: Compulsory for citizens in the country; issued to Rwandans aged 16 registered in the National Population Register (NIDA 'Application for ID'). Valid for travel to Kenya and Uganda (Wikipedia). National ID number widely described as 16 digits (1 + birth year + sex digit + serial + check) - NOT confirmed by a source reached (web search budget exhausted). A Digital ID (e-Ndangamuntu, MOSIP-based) enrolment began 2025-2026 (NIDA news). Card validity and MRZ not found.

name: Passeport / Passport (République du Bénin; ECOWAS e-passport)
mrz_optional: unknown (NPI being integrated into the passport per ANIP 2026)
notes: No data-page specimen or issuer statement of the number format found: the only Commons file linked by en-wiki (File:Benin_Biometric_Passport.png) is the cover; PRADO (BEN-AO-01001..03001) not reachable. Validity 6 years for the ordinary biometric passport (en-wiki citing DEI, retrieved Oct 2021); search snippets of older PRADO models give 6, 7 and 3 years (not current). New electronic passport system announced by the government early 2021 (mondaq/envoy alert) - start year approximate. Issued by DEI (Direction de l'Émigration et de l'Immigration). ANIP ID4Africa 2026 lists 'intégration du NPI au passeport' as a reform.

name: Carte nationale d'identité biométrique (CNIB)
mrz_optional: unknown (NPI likely)
notes: ANIP (ID4Africa 2026 presentation): CNIB issued by ANIP from the RNPP, ECOWAS travel document, contains the holder's NPI and a chip, valid 5 years, 6,000 FCFA; ~2 million issued. In force since 2020 (cio-mag); ECOWAS/ICAO compliant per ANIP, MRZ not seen. Compulsory for Beninese aged 18+, can be issued to minors at parents' request (lanouvelletribune 2020). NPI (Numéro Personnel d'Identification, law 2017-08 RNPP; decree 2020-100): unique, 'inintelligible', non-repeating, for life; length not confirmed by a source (10 digits often cited, unverified). Card number format not found. Separate Certificat d'Identification Personnelle (CIP/'fID') carries the NPI, valid 5 years (not an ID card).

name: Burundian passport / Passeport burundais / Pasipoti (East African Community biometric)
notes: Validity 10 years per English Wikipedia infobox (no issuer source). 52-page EAC biometric booklet (sky blue ordinary). Wikipedia data-page field list includes 'Serial number of the passport' and 'Personal identity number' (the national ID number printed separately; may be in MRZ optional data - unverified). Number format unknown; Commons has only 'Паспорт Бурунди.png' (cover).

name: Carte Nationale d'Identité (CNI) / Ikarata Karangamuntu
notes: Compulsory; valid for travel within the EAC; a new biometric CNI was planned for 2025 (Wikipedia list of identity card policies). Current card is a paper/laminated communal document; no number format, validity or minimum age found.

name: Passeport / جواز سفر (République tunisienne)
mrz_optional: unknown (blurred)
notes: Real document (File:TunisianPassID.png), number blurred: data page shows issue 25-10-2017 -> expiry 24-10-2022 (5 years, day_before) and an 'Identity N°' field (the 8-digit CIN). Current passport (2014 design, File:Interieur_Passeport_Tunisie_2014.jpg) is not biometric; children could be included until 15 per the booklet notice. A biometric passport (10 years adults, 5 years under 15) has been legislated/announced (lapresse.tn, managers.tn 2024-2025) but rollout not confirmed as of late 2025. en-wiki infobox: 5 years.

name: Carte d'identité nationale (CIN) / بطاقة التعريف الوطنية
notes: Current CIN: plastic card since 1993 with barcode, no MRZ, no expiry (World Bank ID4D diagnostic, table 9: expiration none, adults 18+, CIN number of 8 sequential digits, no check digit). Validation libraries agree on 8 digits (first digit 0 or 1 in circulation). Minors can get it exceptionally with guardian consent. A chip biometric ID card was legislated (2024 law) with card number and expiry; launch announced as imminent in Sept 2025 (lapresse.tn); its format unknown.

name: Haitian passport / Passeport haïtien (République d'Haïti)
mrz_optional: NINU (10 digits) from 2026 per press; previously NIF
notes: Canada IRB responses (2009, 2017): number = 2 letters + digits; the letters reportedly code the place of application (CU Curaçao, RL Orlando, TA Ottawa, ML Montréal), digits pre-printed in the booklet, random. Digit count not found (no specimen). From Jan 2026 the personal-ID number printed in passports switched from the NIF to the 10-digit NINU (iciHaiti / Le Relief headlines).

name: Carte d'identification nationale unique (CINU) / Kat idantifikasyon nasyonal
notes: IRB/ecoi 2025 compilation citing an ONI sample: card number alphanumeric, 9 characters ('9 digits and letters'); NINU personal number 10 digits, lifelong, assigned from birth (decree June 2020). Card back shows 'numbers, letters and chevrons' (likely a td1 MRZ, not confirmed). Validity: sources say 10 years; the 2005 decree had renewal every 10 years on the birthday, a 2017 bill 15 years. New Dermalog card from 2017/2018; old CIN (2005 decree; 17- and 14-digit numbers) invalid since Oct 2020. Issued from age 18.

name: Belgian passport (Belgisch paspoort / Passeport belge / Belgischer Reisepass)
mrz_optional: empty
notes: 2022 model specimen (SPECIMEN Olivia, nationality UTO): no. GA0007805 = 2 letters + 7 digits (9 chars), issued 07 02 2022, expires 06 02 2029 (7 years, day_before); MRZ GA00078050UTO9707210F2902061<<<<<<<<<<<<<<00, optional field empty. Older model (2017 specimen SPECIMEN Emma): TA000000 = 2 letters + 6 digits, MRZ TA000000<3 (8-char number padded with '<'), issued 28 03 2017, expires 27 03 2019 (also day_before; 2-year specimen). Purview 'two letters + six digits' matches only the older series, so both 8- and 9-character numbers circulate until ~2029. Meaning of the letter pair (series) not documented. Validity confirmed by diplomatie.belgium.be and municipal tariff sheets (7 y adults since 2014; 5 y under 18). Issuer FOD Buitenlandse Zaken; the Belgian national register number is not in the passport MRZ on either specimen. PRADO not reachable (403).

name: Belgian electronic identity card (eID; Identiteitskaart / Carte d'identité / Personalausweis)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:New_Belgian_ID_(2021)_(front).png ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:New_Belgian_ID_(2021)_(back).png ; https://arthurdejong.org/python-stdnum/doc/2.1/stdnum.be.eid (cites IBZ: xxx-xxxxxxx-yy, yy = first 10 digits mod 97, 0 -> 97) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgian_identity_card
validity_source: https://www.belgium.be/nl/familie/identiteit/identiteitskaart ; https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/2026/03/30/elektronische-identiteitskaart-eid/ (30-year cards for 75+ being reduced back to 10 years)
mrz_optional: line 2: national register number (rijksregisternummer, 11 digits YYMMDDsssCC) e.g. 95022899874, then composite check
notes: Card number = 10 digits + 2 check digits (mod 97 of the first 10; remainder 0 -> 97); printed grouped 3-7-2 ('000-0011157-02'). Specimen check verified: 0000011157 mod 97 = 2. 12 digits exceed the TD1 9-char field, so the MRZ uses the ICAO overflow: IDBEL000001115<7027<<< (first 9 digits, '<' instead of check digit, remaining 3 digits + check digit in optional data). Specimen (2021 model, Eupen, nationality UTO): issued 06 01 2020, expires 06 01 2030 (same_day, 10 y). Leading 3 digits on real cards (e.g. 59x/60x series) not verified - specimen uses 000. Rijksregisternummer printed on front ('95.02.28-998.74' = birth date YY.MM.DD + 3-digit serial (odd male / even female) + 2 check digits mod 97, +2000000000 for births from 2000) and in MRZ line 2. Validity: 10 y (18+), 6 y (12-17), 30 y from 75 (2026 reform reduces to 10 y, date not confirmed); card compulsory from 15, issued from 12. Under 12: separate Kids-ID (3 y validity, not covered here). Issued by municipalities on behalf of FOD Binnenlandse Zaken/IBZ. Card for foreigners uses the same layout with other letters. The 2020-model Commons files (Belgium_ID_2020_*) show 000-5906961-01, which fails the mod 97 check.

name: Papua New Guinea Passport (English only)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Papua_New_Guinean_passport (infobox: "5 years after date of issue", unsourced); https://icsa.gov.pg/passports/apply-for-or-renew-a-passport (ICSA application page: fee PGK 100, child checklist "18 and under"; states no validity)
notes: No specimen found on Commons (only covers) or ICSA site. Validity 5 years per Wikipedia only (Wikipedia 'Passport validity' calls 5 years former practice; no official confirmation either way); a 10-year claim seen online came from an Indian High Commission notice about Indian passports, not PNG ones. ICSA website (icsa.gov.pg) and PacLII (Cloudflare) blocked deeper lookups. Issued by ICSA (formerly ICA), Port Moresby; FA 81 form.

name: National Identity (NID) Card
validity_source: https://www.thenational.com.pg/?p=100993 (The National 2016: Civil and Identity Registry issues NID cards to people aged 18 and over; NID is the legal universal identity)
notes: Issued by the PNG Civil and Identity Registry (Department of National Planning) since ~2015; Wikipedia lists it as compulsory. No specimen or number format found; card number vs NID number structure unknown. Biometric/digital ID programme ongoing (biometricupdate.com 2025).

name: Passport / جواز سفر, Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
notes: No specimen data page found (only a cover on Commons; enwiki lists a 'passport serial number' field without format). Validity 5 years per enwiki infobox, no age split. Chip e-passport issued since 2025 (Jordan Times: 'Jordan rolls out electronic passports'); older MRPs valid until expiry. Enwiki distinguishes a 'regular passport with a national number' (citizens) from passports without one (e.g. West Bank Palestinians holding temporary Jordanian passports) - a generator should only use the citizen type.

name: Personal identity card / البطاقة الشخصية (Smart ID), Civil Status and Passports Department
notes: Smart (chip) ID cards issued since 2016 (Jordan Times). The 10-digit national number (الرقم الوطني) introduced after the Passports and Civil Status departments merged (ProZ forum) is printed on the card; a separate card/document number exists on smart cards but its format was not found. National number structure commonly reported as starting 9 (men) / 2 (women) + birth year - unverified. First issued at 16, compulsory by 18 (enwiki policy list). Validity not found. No specimen on Commons.

name: Pasaporte boliviano (Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia, electrónico since 2018)
mrz_optional: 'No. Serie' value, 7 digits in specimen (4788633), probably the cédula number
notes: DIGEMIG specimen (ABIGAIL CABAÑA FLORES): passport no. AA00001, MRZ 'AA00001<<7' (7 chars padded to 9); issued 01 FEB 2018, expires 01 FEB 2024 (6 years, same day). The number looks like a first-of-series specimen value, so the real digit count may differ (unconfirmed by a second source). Validity 6 years per es.wikipedia infobox; age-dependent rules not found.

name: Cédula de identidad (Bolivia), SEGIP
notes: No specimen seen. es.wikipedia: current citizen format since 1 Nov 2023 (DS 4924) has a 'Código de Lectura Mecánica' on the front bottom (MRZ type not confirmed); fields include cédula number and an optional 'complemento' code (used to disambiguate duplicates, e.g. '1E'); foreigners' polycarbonate card (2019) has an ICAO 9303-compliant number. Cédula numbers are sequential digits (7 digits common, seen as passport 'No. Serie' 4788633); digit range given here is a hint only. Validity 10 years (DS 4342/2020), indefinite from age 58 and for severe disability; es.wikipedia infobox also lists 5 y (physical) / 2 y (digital) up to 58 - conflict unresolved. Issued from birth (minors show parents' data). [merge 2026-11-04] Pattern #{5,8} removed: no evidence.

name: Passport / جواز سفر, United Arab Emirates
notes: Purview (and enwiki, copying it) says 9 alphanumerics from 0-9 and C F G H J K L M N P R T V W X Y Z, not all digits - this is exactly the German passport alphabet and looks copied; no specimen confirms it, so not used. Only Commons data page is a real document with number and MRZ blacked out: issue 28/06/2018, expiry 27/06/2023 (5 years, day_before; holder's age unknown). Validity per enwiki infobox: 10 years for 21 and over, 5 years under 21.

name: Emirates ID / بطاقة الهوية (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security)
mrz_optional: 15-digit Emirates ID number (uqudo: 'opt1 contains the identity number')
notes: The MRZ document-number field holds a separate card number (uqudo lists documentNumber and cardNumber apart from identityNumber); its format was not found - pattern left empty. The 15-digit ID number is well documented: 784-YYYY-NNNNNNN-C (784 = ISO numeric code of the UAE, YYYY = birth year, 7-digit serial, Luhn check digit; u.ae: 15 digits; Purview: 3-4-7-1 with optional hyphens, Luhn). Illustration on Commons shows 784-1234-1134567-1 (placeholder) with birth 29/09/2004 and issue 08/08/2021. Validity for Emiratis: 5 years under 21, 10 years 21+; GCC nationals 5 years; residents follow the visa. Issued from birth; biometrics from 15.

name: Passport (Cestovní pas)
mrz_optional: personal number (rodné číslo, 10 digits without the slash)
notes: Specimen number 8 digits (MRZ "99009054<" padded); Purview "eight digits" agrees. Specimen issued 29.07.2006, expires 29.07.2016 -> same_day. Rodné číslo printed as YYMMDD/NNNN (women: month +50), MRZ optional data = the 10 digits. Validity 5 years under 15, 10 years from 15 (cannot be extended). Newer biometric generations (2007/2012/2023 designs) assumed to keep the 8-digit shape (not verified with a newer specimen).

name: Identity card (Občanský průkaz)
mrz_optional: empty (filled with <)
notes: Document number 9 digits on both the 2012 specimen (998000398, issued 10.01.2012, expires 10.01.2022) and the 2021 specimen (998009476, issued 02.08.2021, expires 02.08.2031) -> same_day; the 998 prefix may be a specimen range. Back shows the personal number (rodné číslo) 10 digits as YYMMDD/NNNN (women: month +50), not in the MRZ. Front shows a 6-digit CAN. Validity: 5 years under 15, 10 years from 15, 35 years from 70, 1 year if fingerprints temporarily impossible (12+). Compulsory from 15 for residents, can be issued on request from birth. 2021 model (2 August 2021) follows EU Reg. 2019/1157.

name: Pasaporte dominicano (República Dominicana; biometric e-passport since Feb 2026)
mrz_optional: placeholder digits in sample (expected: cédula number, printed as 'Núm. personal' 001-0000000-1)
notes: Official 2026 e-passport sample (DGP presentation, CC0 on Commons): printed number S12345678 (1 letter + 8 digits, placeholder digits), document type PP, personal number = cédula; but the sample MRZ carries 'RD0000000<8' as document number, so the sample is internally inconsistent and the real MRZ/number layout is unconfirmed. Sample dates: issued 11-07-2019, expires 11-07-2029 (10 y, same day; illustrative). Validity 10 years adults (previous model 6 years per Regula), 5 years minors (Revista Mercado; age limit of 'minor' assumed 18). Machine-readable (non-chip) passports from 1997 coexist until expiry; their number format not found.

name: Cédula de Identidad y Electoral (CIE), Junta Central Electoral
mrz_optional: unknown (specimen too small to read reliably)
notes: Cédula number = 11 digits: 3-digit series (formerly municipality of first issue; new numbers in series 402) + 7-digit sequence + Luhn check digit (en.wikipedia; python-stdnum agrees), lifelong, also used as taxpayer/driver-licence number. 2026 polycarbonate card with chip (issued from Feb/Apr 2026; old card valid until 31 Mar 2027): JCE sample shows 001-0000000-9, MRZ line 1 starts 'IDDOM' followed by the cédula digits (the 11-digit number exceeds the 9-char field; exact split not legible), a separate card serial (e.g. 012345 / CV0000000000) and 'Cédula anterior' field. Validity by age at issue (JCE FAQ via Revista Mercado): 16-17 until majority, 18-35: 12 y, 36-60: 16 y, 61+: 20 y (validity column uses non-standard 'until 18' for minors). Previous 2014 card also had an MRZ. Voting cards from 18; minors' card from 16 (12+ authorised per later JCE decision). [merge 2026-11-04] Ages 16-17: card valid until the 18th birthday (not a fixed term; generator rule needed).

name: Portuguese passport (Passaporte Eletrónico Português, PEP)
number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:PRTpassportdatapage.png (specimen data page, fair use); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-portugal-passport-number (one letter + six digits, agrees)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portuguese_passport (infobox: 5 years aged 5 and above, 2 years 4 and under; Decreto-Lei 83/2000 not re-read)
mrz_optional: civil identification number (8 digits, e.g. 99999999) + filler, with check digit
notes: Specimen GARÇÃO DE MAGALHÃES Inês, type PX, no. I700044, issued 16.06.2017, expires 16.06.2022 (same_day, 5 years). MRZ line 2: I700044<<9PRT7404076F2206161 99999999<<<<<<80 (number padded with '<' to 9). Field 8 'Nº de identificação pessoal' = civil ID number (número de identificação civil, 8 digits) shared with the Cartão de Cidadão. Meaning of the letter (series) unknown; only 'I' seen. Issuer: SEF (now AIMA/IRN).

name: Portuguese citizen card (Cartão de Cidadão)
number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Portugal_Identity_Card_-_Cart%C3%A3o_de_Cidad%C3%A3o,_New_model_2024.png ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Portugal_Identity_Card,_new_model_(Back).png ; Microsoft Purview sit-defn-portugal-citizen-card-number (8 digits + 1 digit + 2 chars + 1 check digit, agrees)
validity_source: https://www.gov.pt/en/servicos/pedir-o-cartao-de-cidadao (refers to Portaria 287/2017 for validity); en.wikipedia Cartão de Cidadão infobox (10 years aged 25+, 5 years under 25)
mrz_optional: overflow of the document number: version chars + check digit (e.g. 'ZY89'); document number field holds 8-digit civil ID + its check digit, followed by '<'
notes: Document number (Nº documento) = civil identification number (8 digits, permanent, shared with the passport personal-number field) + 1 check digit + 2-char card version (letters/digits, e.g. ZY, ZZ) + 1 check digit; 12 characters, so the TD1 MRZ uses the ICAO overflow: I<PRT426349253<ZY89<<<... (doc field '426349253', check digit replaced by '<', remainder 'ZY8' + overall check '9' in optional data). 2024 model image (fair use) shows expiry 01 04 2034; issue date not on the card, so expiry rule unknown. Back shows tax (NIF, 9 digits), social security (11 digits) and health (9 digits) numbers. Mandatory from birth (request within 20 days). New EU-format card (Reg. 2019/1157) since 10 Jun 2024. Old Bilhete de Identidade (BI) still exists for some cases abroad.

name: Swedish passport (Svenskt pass)
validity_source: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/pass-och-nationellt-id-kort/svar-pa-vanliga-fragor-om-pass/ ('Pass och nationellt id-kort är giltigt i fem år för personer över 12 år ... för barn under 12 år är giltigt i tre år')
mrz_optional: personnummer, 12 digits YYYYMMDDNNNC (e.g. 198208212384), then '<<'
notes: 2022 model specimen (SPECIMEN Svea, Polismyndigheten): no. XA0000001 (2 letters + 7 digits; 'XA' + zeros looks like a specimen series, so only the shape is taken), issued 01 JAN 22, expires 01 JAN 27 (same_day, 5 y). MRZ line 2: XA00000012SWE8208215F2701013198208212384<<22 - optional field carries the 12-digit personnummer (century included), while the data page prints the 10-digit form 820821-2384 (field 3a). Page also prints a 6-digit CAN. Purview says 8 digits, which matches pre-2022 passports (not confirmed on a specimen; still in circulation until ~2027). No issuer statement of the number format found (Polisen FAQ silent). Newborns without an approved name get a passport valid until the day before they turn 3 months. Issuer: Polismyndigheten.

name: Swedish national identity card (Nationellt identitetskort)
mrz_optional: line 1: personnummer, 12 digits YYYYMMDDNNNC (198208212384) after the document-number check digit
notes: 2021-2 model specimen (SPECIMEN Svea): card no. XA0000002, same series/shape as the passport (2 letters + 7 digits; 'XA' + zeros = specimen, shape only); issued 01 JAN 22, expires 01 JAN 27 (same_day). MRZ I<SWEXA00000023198208212384<<< / 8208215F2701013SWE<<<<<<<<<<<2 / SPECIMEN<<SVEA. Front prints personnummer 820821-2384 (10 digits; Luhn check on last digit) and a 6-digit CAN. Voluntary, only for Swedish citizens; issued by Polisen; no minimum age (newborns too). Cards issued before 2 Aug 2021 to under-12s were valid 5 years. Separate Skatteverket ID card (identitetskort för folkbokförda, since 2023?) not covered.

name: Passport / Шиноснома (Shinosnoma), Republic of Tajikistan (biometric)
notes: No data page on Commons or any-language wiki (inside cover only); PRADO not reachable; no official format. Only hint: a Russian accounting forum (asker, unconfirmed) says the number is 9 digits with no series letters (pattern would be #{9}; not used). Biometric passports since 1 February 2010. Validity 10 years; children under 16: 3 to 5 years 'depending on age' (MFA via ruwiki/avesta.tj, exact bands unknown - 5 used as upper bound). Earlier non-biometric books 1993-2010; 2002 diplomatic passport used 'D' + 6 digits (Keesing).

name: Identity card / Шаҳодатномаи шахсият (Корти миллӣ), Republic of Tajikistan
notes: No specimen found (Commons search for Tajik ID card returns nothing). Presidential decree of 20 Sept 2013; issuance began 1 April 2014 (Dushanbe first); plastic card with photo, name, personal number, signature, biometrics in text, machine-readable and chip form (so an MRZ is likely, td1 not confirmed); cards replace the 16-page internal passport, which stays valid until expiry (internal passport 2010 model on Commons: number field 'Шиносномаи №', redacted). Enwiki policy row: compulsory, electronic, Tajik and English since 2015. Validity, minimum age and number format not found.

name: Passport (Διαβατήριο)
mrz_optional: empty (filled with <)
notes: Specimen (placeholder-like number AA1234567) and Purview "two letters + seven digits" agree on the shape; real series letters not verified. Specimen issued 11 DEC 2023, expires 10 DEC 2033 -> day_before. Validity: 10 years from 14 for passports issued from 1 September 2022 (Law 4962/2022; before that 5 years), 3 years under 14. Specimen also prints height. en.wikipedia notes a new generation (polycarbonate data page) whose MRZ starts "PP<GRC" (doc type PP) – this specimen shows "P<GRC".

name: Identity card (Δελτίο Ταυτότητας)
notes: New biometric card issued since 25 September 2023: card number top right = 1 letter + 8 digits (official specimen Z00013425, issued 05 09 2023, expires 04 09 2033 -> day_before; an earlier design mock-up shows A12345678 with 19 12 2019 -> 19 12 2029, not used for expiry_rule). Front also has a 6-digit CAN. Validity 10 years (en.wikipedia; whether minors get a shorter term not verified). Compulsory from 12. Old paper cards (1-2 Greek-and-Latin-shared letters + dash + 6 digits, e.g. "AB-123456"; Purview pattern) valid until 3 August 2026 at the latest, no MRZ. MRZ optional data not seen (back not read). Purview Greek ID pattern describes only the old card.

name: Passport / Pasport, Republic of Azerbaijan (biometric)
mrz_optional: FIN (personal identification number), 7 alphanumerics (specimen 30LJV5Z)
notes: Official SPECIMEN (2013 biometric, polycarbonate): Passport No X11000344, document type PC (MRZ 'PCAZE...' - a generator should emit PC, not P<), Personal No (FIN) 30LJV5Z, issue 02.08.2013, expiry 01.08.2023 (10 years, day_before). MRZ line 2: X110003442AZE7503153M2308010 30LJV5Z<<<<<<<86. Letter X is probably a specimen series; real books are commonly reported as C + 8 digits (not confirmed). FIN: 7 characters, digits and capitals (exact alphabet not documented). Validity per enwiki infobox: 1 year under 1, 3 years under 3, 5 years 3-18, 10 years over 18 (age boundaries approximate). New series design 2024 (Regula).

name: Identity card / Şəxsiyyət vəsiqəsi, Republic of Azerbaijan (biometric chip card; Ministry of Internal Affairs / ASAN)
mrz_optional: probably the FIN (personal identification number, 7 chars, letters and digits, never letter O, e.g. 5VBK5VR per OECD TIN sheet); not seen on a specimen
notes: Commons has a blank official SAMPLE (front: Card No (Vəsiqənin nömrəsi) and Personal No (Fərdi identifikasiya nömrəsi) fields, date of expiry; back: chip, place of birth, blood group, MRZ box 'Maşınla oxuna bilən hissə') - no number shown. Card-number format not found (commonly cited AZE + 8 digits for new cards and AA + 7 digits for older ones is UNCONFIRMED, not used). Law 432-VIQD (20 Dec 2021): card issued under 5 valid until age 5; card issued at 5+ valid until age 15; mandatory from 15 (MIA law text: 'reached the age of 15 years ... must receive an identity card within one month'). Adult card: validity 'varies', replacement at ages 25, 35 and 50 (Regula) - adult term not confirmed. Biometric cards since 1 Sept 2018 (enwiki); earlier chip card 2013. FIN format: OECD TIN PDF (https://oecd.org/tax/automatic-exchange/crs-implementation-and-assistance/tax-identification-numbers/Azerbaijan-TIN.pdf), printed as 'Personal No' on new cards.

name: Passport / דרכון (Darkon), State of Israel
mrz_optional: Israeli ID number (9 digits) apparently, followed by its check digit (redacted on the 2003 real document; length consistent with 9 + check)
notes: Both Commons data pages are real documents, redacted: shape only. 2013 biometric page shows an unredacted 8-digit number printed vertically beside the photo (likely the perforated passport/booklet number); the 2003 page's MRZ line 2 shows the document number followed by one '<' filler before its check digit, i.e. 8 characters - consistent with 8 digits. Not confirmed by an issuer. 2003 page: issue 17/11/2003, expiry 16/11/2013 (10 years, day_before). Validity: 10 years for adults (enwiki: up to 10 years for 18+); 5 years for minors per secondary sources (some 2017 sources say under 16). Infobox also lists 1-year documents (short-validity passports for special cases). Biometric passports since 2012/2013, exclusive since June 2017.

name: Identity card / תעודת זהות (Teudat Zehut) / بطاقة هوية, biometric smart card
notes: Pattern given is the 9-digit ID number (mispar zehut), last digit Luhn check (enwiki; Purview: nine digits with checksum) - leading zeros allowed. A separate card/document number on the biometric card and an MRZ were not confirmed by any source; if the card has a distinct document number, it is unknown. Biometric card since 2013 pilot, all new cards since June 2017; old non-biometric cards expired by 2022/2024. Must be carried from 16. Temporary residents' cards follow visa length.

name: Pasaporte hondureño (República de Honduras, electrónico since Mar 2022)
notes: Number format not found (no data-page specimen on Commons; INM publishes none). E-passport issued since March 2022 (Tegucigalpa, Choluteca, Juticalpa); older passports valid until expiry. Applicant chooses 5 or 10 years; 10-year passports not issued to people under 21 (so 21+: 5 or 10; value above is the maximum).

name: Documento Nacional de Identificación (DNI), RNP
notes: New DNI (issued from 2021; old tarjeta de identidad invalid from 1 Jan 2022) has a 3-line x 30 MRZ (line 1: type, country, document number) per La Prensa 2020; the card/document number format is not documented. Personal identity number: 13 digits, first 4 = department (01-18) + municipality of registration, next 4 = year of birth registration, last 5 = sequence (commonly written ####-####-#####; third-party nationid spec, low confidence; no public check digit). Validity period not found.

name: Pasaporte cubano (República de Cuba)
notes: Number format not found (no data-page specimen located; MININT publishes none). Since 1 Jul 2023 passports are valid 10 years with no extensions; earlier ones were valid 6 years with two 2-year 'prórrogas' (es.wikipedia). Minors 5 years per es.wikipedia infobox (not confirmed by issuer).

name: Carné de identidad (Cuba)
notes: Card/document number format unknown. Personal number (número de identidad): 11 digits, YYMMDD birth date + century digit + 2 sequence digits + sex digit (even male / odd female) + check digit (lookuptax guide; python-stdnum cu.ni confirms 11 digits with birth date and sex). Compulsory from 16 (en.wikipedia). A 2024-2025 identity law project introduces a permanent identity number and an expiry date on a new document (cubanet / directoriocubano); validity of the current card not found.

name: Passport (Útlevél / Magánútlevél)
mrz_optional: empty (filled with <)
notes: Specimen number 2 letters + 7 digits (BD0002028), issued 01 MAR 12, expires 01 MAR 22 -> same_day. Purview "two letters + six or seven digits": 6-digit numbers may be older series (not verified). Validity per law: 3 years until age 6, 5 years 6-18, 10 years over 18; embassy fee tables also list a 5-year option for adults and 1-year passports for minors in some cases.

name: Identity card (Személyazonosító igazolvány; eSzemélyi since 2016)
notes: Card number ("Okmányazonosító/Doc. No.") = 6 digits + 2 letters; specimen shows placeholder 000000XX, Hungarian MFA consulate Ügyfélkapu guide states "6 digits and 2 letters"; penzcentrum.hu says the 2000-2015 plastic cards also used 6-digit serial + 2-letter series (letters differ for permanent vs temporary cards). EXPIRY RULE IS SPECIAL: law 29/E (1) sets expiry on the holder's BIRTHDAY following issue + N years (under 12: 3 years, capped at the 12th birthday; 12-17: 3 years; 18+: 6 years); 29 Feb births expire 28 Feb. 70+: holder may request a 10-year card (from issue date). 1-year cards for some cases; temporary card 30 days. Specimen DOB 30.06.1979 / expiry 30.06.2028 consistent with the birthday rule. Card shows a 6-digit CAN (012345 on specimen). Personal identification number (személyi azonosító, 11 digits) is not printed on the card (held on a separate address/personal-number card). Old paper booklet IDs lost validity 3 Aug 2026. MRZ optional data not visible (back specimen blanked). Issued from birth; ID or passport/driving licence required from 14.

name: Austrian passport (Reisepass)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Passport_of_Austria_(2024)_data_page.jpg ; Microsoft Purview sit-defn-austria-passport-number (one letter + optional space + 7 digits)
validity_source: https://www.jusline.at/gesetz/passg/paragraf/11 (PassG §11: 10 years, shorter where the photo will not identify the holder for long, i.e. children) ; https://tirol.gv.at/innsbruck/kinderreisepass (under 2: 2 years; 2-12: 5 years; from 12: 10 years)
mrz_optional: empty
notes: 2023/2024 model specimen (SPECIMEN Maria, specimen no. 00082): passport no. AP1234567 (2 letters + 7 digits, digits are a placeholder sequence), document type code 'PP' (not 'P<'), issued 01.12.2023, expires 30.11.2033 (day_before, 10 y). MRZ PPAUTSPECIMEN<<MARIA<<< / AP12345673AUT0012315F3311307<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<8 - optional field empty; also a 6-digit CAN. Purview's 'one letter + 7 digits' (e.g. P1234567) describes the older series (2006-2023 models, in circulation until ~2033) - conflicts with the 2023 specimen's 2-letter prefix; neither confirmed by the issuer. A real 2021 passport on Commons (Austrian_Passport_Personal_Information_Page_Template.jpg) has its number blurred; type 'P' there, issued 2021, expires 2031. Austria has no national personal number on the document (ZMR/bPK not printed). Issued by Bezirkshauptmannschaften / Magistrate (and Gemeinden on delegation); produced by OeSD.

name: Austrian identity card (Personalausweis)
number_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Austrian_identity_card (specimen images, front and back, 2021 model); Microsoft Purview sit-defn-austria-identity-card (24-character string - that is the bPK/encoded identifier, not the card number)
validity_source: https://www.jusline.at/gesetz/passg/paragraf/19 (PassG §19(2): validity rules of the ordinary passport apply) ; https://www.jusline.at/gesetz/passg/paragraf/11
mrz_optional: empty (line 1 after check digit all '<')
notes: 2021 model specimen (MUSTERFRAU Maria): document no. PA1234567 (2 letters + 7 placeholder digits; 'PA' vs passport 'AP' suggests a document-type prefix, not confirmed), issued 02.08.2021, expires 01.08.2031 (day_before, 10 y). MRZ IDAUTPA12345673<<<<<<<<<<<<<<< / 8112314F3108011AUT<<<<<<<<<<<6 / MUSTERFRAU<<MARIA; CAN 123456. Voluntary card; validity follows the passport rules (PassG §19 -> §11): 10 y from 12, shorter for children (2 y under 2, 5 y 2-11 per municipal pages; one municipal fee sheet (freistadt-rust.at) groups 2-16 at 5 y - fee bracket, not re-checked). No minimum age. Purview 'Austria identity card' (24 chars incl. / + =) is a base64 sector-specific identifier, not the card number - wrong for this purpose. Older card (2002-2021 credit-card model) number format not checked.

name: Biometric passport of a citizen of the Republic of Belarus (Біяметрычны пашпарт грамадзяніна Рэспублікі Беларусь / Биометрический паспорт гражданина Республики Беларусь)
number_example: PD000#### (real 2021 biometric passport, shape only; digits partly blurred on the image)
number_source: https://belarusfacts.by/kcfinder/upload/portal/files/GKU/passport_description.pdf (official description linked from https://mfa.gov.by/visa/biometricheskie_dokumenty/: "серийный номер бланка ... состоящий из двух букв латинского алфавита и семи арабских цифр") ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Biometric_passport_(2021)_of_Belarus,_the_data_page.webp
validity_source: https://news.zerkalo.io/life/2301.html (via search snippet: 10 years, 5 years under 14) ; https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Паспорт_гражданина_Республики_Беларусь
mrz_optional: identification number (идентификационный номер, 14 characters)
notes: Biometric passport (Decree No. 107 of 16 March 2021, issued from 1 Sept 2021): number = 2 Latin letters + 7 digits (official MFA/belarusfacts description; real passport shows PD prefix). Real passport issued 22.10.2021, expires 22.10.2031 -> same_day. MRZ optional data = identification number, e.g. shape #{7}@#{3}@{2}# (digit for sex/century, DDMMYY, region letter, 3-digit serial, citizenship code PB/BA/BI, check digit; real example 3040591E022PB0). OLD 1996-model passport (still valid to expiry, combined internal + travel booklet, data page TD3) also 2 letters + 7 digits, the letters being a regional series (e.g. MP Minsk city, MC Minsk region, AB Brest, BM Vitebsk, HB Gomel, KH Grodno, KB Mogilev, PP MFA; from general knowledge of the series, not verified here); old passports issued after 45 were once valid to age 100, recent ones 10 years. Validity for 64+ not confirmed (Charter97 text mentions "14 to 64" for 10 years). Belarusian government sites (pravo.by, mvd.gov.by) returned 403.

name: Identity card (Ідэнтыфікацыйная карта грамадзяніна Рэспублікі Беларусь / Идентификационная карта гражданина Республики Беларусь)
number_example: AA1516310 (official sample image from mpt.gov.by, low resolution, reading uncertain); real card MRZ starts IDBLRBY... (shape only)
mrz_optional: identification number (14 characters)
notes: Нумар карткі / Номер карты / Document number = 2 letters + 7 digits read off the low-resolution official sample (AA1516310); a real card's MRZ line 1 begins IDBLR + "BY" + 7 hidden characters, consistent with a 2-letter series. No official text on the card number format found (unlike the passport). Real card issued 25.10.2021, expires 25.10.2031 -> same_day. MRZ optional data (line 1) = identification number (e.g. 3040591E022PB0, printed on the front). Issued from 1 Sept 2021 for domestic use (Decree No. 107); 14 is a basis for issue (ilex.by snippet); compulsory ID (passport or ID card) at 14. Not compulsory to switch: 1996-model passports remain valid as internal ID until expiry. Cards for foreigners also exist (not covered).

name: Swiss passport (Schweizer Pass / Passeport suisse / Passaporto svizzero / Passaport svizzer), model Pass 22
number_source: https://www.travelnews.ch/english-corner/26038-how-can-you-distinguish-between-a-zero-and-an-o-in-a-passport.html (fedpol spokesperson: no fixed public structure any more; letters O and I not used; Pass 10 numbers began with 'X' + 7 digits) ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Swiss_passport_data_page_sample.jpg
mrz_optional: empty
notes: Pass 10 sample data page (de Maienfeld Pierre, type 'PM'): no. S2100023 (8 chars), issued 01.03.2010, expires 29.02.2020 (day_before), MRZ S2100023<6CHE7108019M2002293<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<6 (8-char number padded with '<'; optional field empty). Current Pass 22 (since 31 Oct 2022): fedpol says the number has no published fixed structure; 8 characters, letters and digits, O and I never used, zero printed with a centre dot - pattern [A-HJ-NP-Z0-9]{8} is our inference (length from the 2023 ID-card specimen, same series rules), not stated by fedpol. Real Pass 10 numbers: 'X' + 7 digits (still valid until ~2032). Type code on Swiss passports is 'PM' (not 'P<'). No personal number on Swiss documents (AHV number not printed). PRADO not reachable.

name: Swiss identity card (Identitätskarte / Carte d'identité / Carta d'identità / Carta d'identitad), model 2023
mrz_optional: empty
notes: 2023 specimen (SCHWEIZER SAMPLE Helvetia, Bern BE): card no. S1A00A00 (8 chars, mixed letters/digits), issued 23 03 2023, expires 22 03 2033 (day_before, 10 y). MRZ IDCHES1A00A00<9<<<<<<<<<<<<<<< / 9508015F3303228CHE<<<<<<<<<<<2 / SCHWEIZER<SAMPLE<<HELVETIA (8-char number padded with '<'). fedpol: no published fixed structure; O and I excluded; zero with centre dot. Voluntary; any age; issued via cantonal passport offices or (in many cantons) municipalities. Older card models (2003/2007) used other number shapes (not checked) and stay valid until ~2033. No personal number on the card.

name: Passport (Republic of Sierra Leone; ECOWAS e-passport)
mrz_optional: unknown (NIN required for passport application since 1 June 2022)
notes: No specimen data page or issuer statement of the number format found (Commons/en-wiki: covers only). E-passport launched 2015 (citizenshiprightsafrica, VP Joh), produced by Netpage SL with HID Global; en-wiki says a new ICAO-compliant chip passport launched 2022. Validity 5 years per en-wiki ECOWAS passport table (Immigration Department), not confirmed by the issuer; no minor-specific rule found. Since 1 June 2022 the NCRA NIN is a precondition for passports (biometricupdate 2022-05).

name: National Identity Card (NCRA multipurpose biometric ID card)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: NCRA (National Civil Registration Authority, NCR Act 2016) assigns the NIN and issues multipurpose chip ID cards; available to citizens aged 12+ (Calabash Newspaper 2024-10-30); non-citizens get a Non-National ID card. NIN described as an 11-digit unique identifier (Calabash, secondary; #{11} unconfirmed by NCRA). Validity 5 years per a 2015 IRB/ecoi document on the earlier card; current card validity not found. Card number format and MRZ presence not found. en-wiki ID-card policy: 10,000 SLL every 5 years (old).

name: Passeport biométrique / Passport (République togolaise; ECOWAS passport)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: No data-page specimen or issuer statement of the number format found (Commons: none; en-wiki: no number text). Landinfo 2017 (citing DGDN and the Berlin embassy): biometric passports since 2009, issued by DGDN (Direction Générale de la Documentation Nationale, Direction des Passeports et des Cartes Nationales d'Identité), valid 5 years; children have their own passports (no minor-specific validity stated). en-wiki infobox and goafricaonline also say 5 years.

name: Carte nationale d'identité (CNI, DGDN); separately the e-ID Togo card with NIU (ANID)
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Optional (en-wiki policy list): DGDN issues the CNI 'à tout togolais qui en fait la demande' (DGDN page, archived 2018); validity, number format and MRZ not found. Separate foundational ID: law on e-ID Togo (2020) requires every citizen/resident to obtain a NIU (Numéro d'identification unique) from ANID; MOSIP-based; >6 million NIUs by end 2025 (biometricupdate 2026-04); NIU described as 12 inintelligible digits by one 2023 secondary source (#{12}, unconfirmed). The free e-ID card (operational Dec 2024) carries an encrypted, digitally signed QR code (ANID, ID4Africa 2026), no MRZ mentioned; validity not found.

name: Lao passport / ໜັງສືຜ່ານແດນ (Passeport)
number_source: No specimen data page found: Commons has only covers (File:Laos-passport1.jpg, File:Cover of Lao Passport.jpg); no Purview definition; English Wikipedia gives no number format
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laotian_passport (infobox: 10 years after acquisition; unsourced, no age split given)
notes: Current passports carry the e-passport chip symbol (cover photo). Validity for minors not found. Number format unknown (web search budget exhausted).

name: Lao identity card / ບັດປະຈຳຕົວ
number_source: No specimen or format source found (no Commons image, no Purview definition, no English Wikipedia article)
notes: Compulsory for citizens 16+, issued by the police for the Ministry of Home Affairs, biometric/magnetic card distributed since 2015 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_identity_card_policies_by_country). Number format, validity and MRZ unknown.

name: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport / 中華人民共和國香港特別行政區護照
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Data_Page_of_Hong_Kong_SAR_of_P.R.China_Passport.jpg (Immigration Department specimen, 2019 design: H00000000, MRZ H00000000 + check digit)
validity_source: https://www.immd.gov.hk/eng/services/hksar-passport/apply-hksar-passport.html (10 years for 16+, 5 years under 16); specimen 14 MAY 19 -> 14 MAY 29
