notes: Issuing state code is CHN (nationality CHINESE), not HKG. Dates printed with 2-digit years (DD MON YY). Shape only from a placeholder: H + 8 digits. Earlier e-passport series (2007-2019, still valid until 2029) used a different letter prefix (reported K + 8 digits; not confirmed here). Data page shows the HKID number vertically beside the photo.

name: Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card / 香港永久性居民身份證 (HKID, smart identity card)
number_source: Purview sit-defn-hong-kong-identity-card-number (1-2 letters + 6 digits + check character 0-9 or A in brackets); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hong_Kong_identity_card
notes: Card number = HKID number; check digit is mod 11 (A = 10). Single-letter prefix most common (letter shows issue period/category, e.g. A, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, R, S, T, V, Y, Z); two-letter prefixes (e.g. XA, WX) are rare. Card has no expiry date. Children register at 11 (juvenile card), must get an adult card within 30 days of turning 18. Current smart card generation since 2018. No MRZ. Also issued to non-permanent residents (different card title).

name: Passport / جواز سفر (State of Libya)
mrz_optional: unknown (12-digit national number likely printed; not confirmed)
notes: No specimen data page or issuer statement of the number format found (Commons: covers, e.g. File:Libyan_New_Passport.jpg; File:PassportOfLibya_2014-04-08_14-18.jpg could not be downloaded - rate limited - content unchecked). en-wiki: machine-readable passport issued since 2014, 'valid for 8 years for all ages' (unsourced; no issuer confirmation). New blue biometric passport unveiled Feb 2013 tied to the national number system (biometricupdate 2013). National number: 12 digits (Law 8/2014), see LY id_card row.

name: Personal identity card / البطاقة الشخصية
mrz_optional: unknown
notes: Non-compulsory personal ID card issued to residents over 16; eID cards in development as of 2023 (en-wiki ID-card policy list). Validity: 1965 Interior regulation set 4 years, Justice Secretary decision 75 of 1980 set 10 years from issue (lawsociety.ly, via search; current rule not confirmed). Card number format and MRZ not found. National number (الرقم الوطني, Law 8 of 2014 art.2, https://security-legislation.ly/latest-laws/law-no-8-of-2014-on-the-national-id-number/): 12 digits = digit 1 sex (1 male, 2 female) + digits 2-5 birth year + digits 6-11 sequence within year and sex + digit 12 check digit (algorithm not given) -> [12]#{4}#{6}#; obtained via passport and ID applications; >6 million issued by 2013.

name: General civil passport / Паспорт (Кыргыз Республикасынын жалпы жарандык паспорту / общегражданский паспорт), Kyrgyz Republic (2023/2024 model, biometric)
mrz_optional: Personal No. (ПИН), 14 digits (specimen 20509200000000)
notes: Official SPECIMEN of the 2024-series data page: Passport No PE0000000 (2 letters + 7 digits, zeros = placeholder digits, PE likely the current series), also laser-perforated on the facing page; Personal No 20509200000000 (14-digit PIN: first digit sex, then birth date as 8 digits, then 5 digits - specimen shows 05092000 for DOB 09 05 2000, so DDMM order unclear); issue 02 02 2024, expiry 02 02 2034 (10 years, same_day); authority 'KGZ 123456' (KGZ + 6-digit office code). MRZ line 2: PE00000007KGZ0005094M3402029 20509200000000 0 0 - PIN in the optional field. Rules: Government Resolution No. 167 of 12 April 2024 (2023-model passport and 2024-model ID card), previous 2020-model blanks issued until exhausted; from July 2019 children under 16 get their own passport. Children's validity not found (ruwiki gives 10 years flat).

name: Identity card - passport of a citizen / ID-карта (Кыргыз Республикасынын жаранынын паспорту, Инсандык карта), Kyrgyz Republic
mrz_optional: probably the 14-digit PIN (as in the passport MRZ); not seen
notes: No specimen found (Commons has none). Biometric ID card since 1 May 2017 (Government Decree No. 197 of 3 April 2017), 2020 model (adds ethnicity on back), 2024 model (MRZ document code 'I' instead of 'ID'; Resolution No. 167 of 12 April 2024), 2025 model with transparent window. Pre-2017 model 2004 plastic cards (AN series per a 24.kg link title, some without expiry) still in circulation. Card-number format not found (ID + 7 digits commonly assumed, unconfirmed, not used). Validity 10 years implied only (Regula: 'like ID cards, driver's licences are valid for ten years'). Compulsory at 16 (enwiki policy row). PIN 14 digits (see passport row).

name: Passport for exit and entry / Türkmenistanyň raýatlarynyň Türkmenistandan gitmek we Türkmenistana gelmek üçin pasporty (biometric; State Migration Service)
mrz_optional: Personal No. (Şahsy №) present on the data page, starts with two letters (DZ on the 2016 real page); whether it is in the MRZ optional field not visible
notes: Commons 2016 data page (real document, shape only, heavily redacted): Passport No starts with letter A (rest blanked, length unknown); Personal No starts with DZ; issuing authority SMST (State Migration Service of Turkmenistan); type P, code TKM. Biometric passports since 10 July 2008 (decree 9895), new sample April 2013, current version October 2023 (enwiki). Validity up to 5 years for all ages, including children (migration.gov.tm via ruwiki). Embassies stamp 'extensions' on expired passports instead of renewing. Domestic ID is the internal citizenship passport (see id_card row).

name: (no ID card) internal citizenship passport / Türkmenistanyň raýatynyň pasporty (içerki pasport)
notes: Turkmenistan issues no identity card; the domestic identity document is an internal passport booklet ('citizenship passport', enwiki policy list under non-compulsory cards). The internal passport was valid for foreign travel until 10 July 2013 (ruwiki). Commons has internal-passport covers only; its series/number format not found.

name: Pasaporte nicaragüense (República de Nicaragua)
notes: Number format not found (no specimen data page; Migración publishes none). 2001 decree (La Gaceta 11 Sep 2001): ordinary passports valid 5 years from issue, not renewable; machine-readable format with 'Pasaporte Número' field. Current validity may differ (not verified).

name: Cédula de identidad (Nicaragua), Consejo Supremo Electoral
notes: Number format not confirmed by any source found. The cédula number is a lifelong unique number (Ley 152). The display shape commonly seen is 3 digits (municipality) - 6 digits (birth date DDMMYY) - 4 digits + 1 letter (e.g. 001-DDMMYY-0001A), but this is unverified here (hint from general knowledge only). Validity 10 years from issue (Ley 152 art. 33 as reformed 2012/2014). New format from 21 Feb 2026 shows expiry date and QR, no issue date; biometric card announced for 2026. Compulsory from 16.

name: Passport (Пасош / Pasoš)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Passport_of_Serbia_ID,_2009_version.jpg ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SrbPassInfoPage.png (real document, shape only, 9 characters, partly blurred)

name: Identity card (Лична карта / Lična karta)
validity_source: https://paragrafco.co.rs/propisi_download/zakon_o_licnoj_karti.pdf (Zakon o ličnoj karti, Sl. glasnik RS 62/2006, 36/2011, 53/2021, čl. 2, 3, 5)
mrz_optional: JMBG (personal number, 13 digits)
notes: Card number = "Рег. бр. / Reg. No" (registration number), 9 digits; specimen 955555546, MRZ IDSRB955555546 1 2902968000000 (doc number + check digit, then JMBG in optional data). The string on the back (FF2965C0172D0A) is a chip/serial code, not the document number. Specimen issued 24.07.2008, expires 24.07.2013 (5 years for an adult: earlier rule; the law now says 10 years) -> same_day. Law: right to an ID card from 10 ("dete"), compulsory from 16 for residents; children (10-15) get 5 years, others 10 years; 65+ may request a card without chip with unlimited validity (0); citizens without registered residence get 2-year cards. JMBG 13 digits (DDMMYYY + region RR + serial BBB + check K) also printed on the back. Non-chip card variant also exists (same number format assumed, not checked).

name: Singapore passport
number_source: Purview sit-defn-singapore-passport-number (E + 7 digits + letter); EU PRADO register entry SGP-AS-03001 gives the number format ANNNNNNNA (seen only as a search-result snippet; PRADO not reachable): https://www.consilium.europa.eu/prado/en/SGP-AS-03001/index.html ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Singapore_passport (passport number unique per passport since biometric passports, no longer the NRIC number)
validity_source: https://www.ica.gov.sg/news-and-publications/newsroom/media-release/singapore-passports-with-increased-validity-period-of-10-years-from-october-2021 (10 years for 16+ from 1 Oct 2021; under 16: 5 years)
mrz_optional: probably the NRIC number (data page shows the national ID number; not confirmed from a specimen)

Dual citizens capped at the 22nd birthday. Before 2006 the passport number was the holder's NRIC number.

name: National Registration Identity Card (NRIC)
number_source: Purview sit-defn-singapore-national-registration-identity-card-number (letter F/G/M/S/T + 7 digits + check letter); ICA heritage page (seven numerals and a letter; example S0000001/I issued to the first President): https://www.ica.gov.sg/about-ica/about-us/our-heritage/room/national-registration---identification ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Registration_Identity_Card
notes: Card number = NRIC number. Prefix S = citizens/PRs born before 2000, T = born 2000-2099; F/G/M are for foreigners (FIN, not on the pink/blue NRIC). Last letter is a mod-11 check letter (weights 2,7,6,5,4,3,2; offset 4 for T/G). No printed expiry: registration at 15, mandatory re-registration (new card) at 30 and, per ICA, at 55 (introduced 2017; Wikipedia: if born after Jan 1962). No MRZ. Example is historical (from ICA).

name: Pasaporte paraguayo (República del Paraguay, electrónico)

Its card-number format was not found. Treat as exists=no for generation of an ICAO ID card; driving licence and passport are the usual IDs. CPR: DDMMYY-SSSS (covered elsewhere). AltID digital wallet launched 2026 (not a card).

notes: Context: issued by the Palestinian Authority under the 1993 Oslo self-government arrangement (inside cover text: 'issued pursuant to the Palestinian self government agreement according to Oslo agreement signed in Washington on 13/9/1993'), styled 'Passport/Travel Document'; issuer code PSE, cover 'The Palestinian Authority'. Commons SPECIMEN (overprinted, biometric): Passport No 79000754 (8 digits; MRZ 79000754<0 - 8 digits, filler, check digit), ID No 906422530 (9-digit population-registry number, passes the Israeli ID check-digit rule), mother's name field, issue 16/06/2022, expiry 15/06/2027 (5 years, day_before), authority 'MOI'. name: Identity card / بطاقة هوية / תעודת זהות (Palestinian Authority; Civil Status Directorate, Ministry of Interior, subject to Israeli Civil Administration population-registry approval)
notes: Context: the card is issued by the PA Ministry of Interior since Oslo, but the ID numbers come from the population registry Israel created after 1967 and every issuance/registry change needs Israeli approval (enwiki; Wikipedia policy row: 'validity incubated until the Israeli authorities approve it'). Bilingual Arabic/Hebrew laminated paper card in a green plastic wallet (green since early 2000s; earlier orange West Bank, blue East Jerusalem under Israeli administration) with a folded 'ID annex' (address, marital status, spouse ID, children). No MRZ, no expiry date (valid for life unless replaced); compulsory at 16. Number: 9 digits, printed grouped 1+7+1 ('0 0000000 0' on the annex template; last digit is a check digit) - the passport specimen's ID No 906422530 satisfies the Israeli Teudat Zehut Luhn-style check (weights 1,2,1,2..., sum mod 10 = 0), so the same algorithm as IL id_card applies. Real 2020 card on Commons (shape only): issue date 31/05/2020, place of issue Bethlehem.

name: (no national identity card) - Irish passport card (Cárta Pas), the EU-travel card form of the passport
number_source: https://www.oireachtas.ie/en/debates/question/2022-09-08/767 ('An Irish passport card number starts with the letter C, which is followed by 8 digits' - via search snippet)
validity_source: https://cibtvisas.co.uk/irish-passports (5 years or the remaining validity of the holder's passport book, whichever is shorter; en.wikipedia infobox agrees)

Min age 18 per CIBT; PRADO search snippets mention cards for minors valid as long as the book - possible newer extension to children, unconfirmed. Number C + 8 digits (issuer statement). TD1 MRZ assumed for an ID-1 travel card (not seen on a specimen; doc code not verified). Public Services Card (PSC, Dept of Social Protection) is not an identity card in law and is not covered. Judgment call: row set to exists=yes for the passport card; treat as exists=no if the design wants only true national ID cards. [merge 2026-11-04] Owner decision 14 (2026-11-04): no identity card in 1.0, like DK; the passport card facts above are kept for 1.1.

Back shows OIB (11 digits, 10 + ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 check digit; Purview checksum yes) and an MBO/PHIN health-insurance number field; MRZ optional data = OIB. Compulsory from 18 for residents; minors can be issued a card (exact lower age not verified, entered 0).

name: Eritrean passport / ፓስፖርት
notes: Validity 5 years per Chinese Wikipedia citing the Eritrean consulate in Australia 'New Eritrean Passport' page (archived 2011; ru wiki: '5 years or less'). Passports not issued before completion of national/military service; diaspora must pay 2% tax. Number format unknown; Commons has only 'Cover of Eritrean Passport.jpeg'. td3 assumed (machine-readable).

notes: Real document, shape only; digit count of the civil identification number estimated from the blur width (not confirmed). Expiry is tied to the holder's 25th / 45th birthday rather than issue + N years; whether the card issued at 45+ expires is not stated (assumed none). The separate registration number (регистрийн дугаар: two Cyrillic letters + 8 digits, first 6 = birth date; format from general knowledge, not confirmed here) was removed from the physical card in Dec 2022 (https://ikon.mn/n/2qyz). Electronic chip card since 2012; no MRZ visible on the 2022 card. Dates printed YYYY/MM/DD.

name: Pasaporte uruguayo (República Oriental del Uruguay), DNIC
mrz_optional: cédula number without punctuation incl. its check digit (e.g. 099999999 for 09.999.999-9)
notes: DNIC specimen (2015 model, public domain): number 12AB12704 (2 digits + 2 letters + 5 digits; MRZ '12AB12704' + check 8), personal no. = cédula 09.999.999-9 in the MRZ optional field; issued 16 Oct 2015, expires 16 Oct 2020 (5 y, same day - validity was 5 years then). Current validity 10 years (es.wikipedia). 2025 model (real passport on en.wikipedia, shape only): document code 'PP', 'Nacionalidad/Ciudadanía' field, issued 16 Abr 2025, expires 16 Abr 2035 (10 y, same day); its number is blurred, so whether the 2025 series keeps the ##@@##### shape is unconfirmed. The 2025 model was rejected by some countries (no place of birth, URY nationality code) and the previous version was reinstated from 1 Aug 2025, both coexisting (MercoPress, ICAO WP).

name: Documento de identidad / Cédula de identidad (Uruguay), DNIC
notes: Card/document number and MRZ not confirmed (no ID-card specimen found for citizens; Commons has only a foreigners' card image not checked). Personal number = cédula number, shown on the passport specimen as 09.999.999-9: up to 7-8 digits + hyphen + 1 check digit (#.###.###-#). Required from 45 days of age (en.wikipedia); citizens' card blue, residents' yellow with 'EXTRANJERO'. Validity not found.

name: Passport / جواز سفر, State of Qatar
notes: No specimen or data page found (Commons has only cover images; enwiki has no number text; web search found nothing official). Biometric (chip logo on cover). name: Qatar ID (QID) / البطاقة الشخصية (Ministry of Interior)
notes: 11-digit QID: digit 1 = century of birth (2 = 1900s, 3 = 2000s), digits 2-3 = birth year YY, digits 4-6 = ISO 3166 numeric nationality (634 for Qatari citizens), last 5 = sequence (Purview: first digit 2 or 3; Doha Guides/Wego agree on the rest). Example 28425001234 is a French resident (250) from a guide, not a citizen. Validity for citizens not confirmed (third parties say 1-5 years for residents). MRZ presence unknown; no specimen found.

name: Passport / Անձնագիր (Andznagir), Republic of Armenia (biometric; Ministry of Internal Affairs, Migration and Citizenship Service)
mrz_optional: unknown (sample MRZ line 2 is all X: 28 chars after the number block then fillers and 2 check characters, i.e. the optional field looks empty)

Validity 10 years (enwiki, newsarmenia 2026 fee 28,650 AMD); the old 5-year extension was abolished in Aug 2017. ID cards become mandatory from 16 under the amended Law on Identity Documents (Aug 2024 decision; biometricupdate 2026). First ID card 1 June 2012 (PWPW, blank sample on Commons: fields card number, social services number (public service number), MRZ starting 'I<ARM', td1); issuance largely suspended 2023-2026. Enwiki ID-card infobox says validity 5 years after issuance - not confirmed elsewhere, left empty. ID card valid for travel to Georgia (2023).

Commonly described as YYMM of birth + 4-digit serial + check digit - not confirmed. Whether the smart card has a separate document number and an MRZ was not found; no card specimen found. Issued to all residents incl. children (CPR needed for any service). Validity not found. Note: enwiki gives passport validity adults 10 years, children 5 years (BH passport row says minors unknown).

name: Passport / Passaporte (República Democrática de Timor-Leste)
validity_source: https://www.mj.gov.tl/jornal/public/docs/2023/serie_1/SERIE%20I%20N.%2015A.pdf (Decreto-Lei 23/2023 preamble: under DL 52/2016 as amended by DL 12/2017 the e-passport is issued with a maximum validity of five years, not extendable); https://www.dn.pt/lusa/primeiro-passaporte-biometrico-de-timor-leste-atribuido-a-xanana-gusmao-7207834.html (Lusa 2017-05-05: 2 years under 12, 5 years 13-59, 10 years over 60)
notes: Biometric (Gemalto/Thales) e-passport since 5-6 June 2017, regime DL 52/2016 (28 Dec 2016) amended by DL 12/2017; MRZ-capable digital passports since Dec 2007. Validity conflict: Lusa launch report gives 10 years for 60+, but the 2023 decree states a 5-year maximum; recorded the decree (5) with Lusa's under-12 = 2 years (12-year-olds ambiguous in Lusa). DL 23/2023 extended expiring e-passports to 5 May 2024 (booklet shortage). No data-page specimen found (Commons has covers only); PRADO lists TLS-AO-02001 but was not consulted per brief. Issued by Direção Nacional de Identificação Civil e Registo Criminal (Ministry of Justice).

name: Identity Card / Bilhete de Identidade (BI)
validity_source: https://www.mj.gov.tl/jornal/public/docs/2002_2005/decreto_lei_governo/2_2004.pdf (Decreto-Lei 2/2004, art. 17: valid 5 years if issued before 60; lifetime if issued or renewed at 60+)
notes: DL 2/2004 art. 5: obtaining the BI is compulsory for nationals; art. 7: the BI number is a sequential number followed by check digits ('faixa numérica sequencial, seguido de dígitos de controlo'), kept unchanged on renewal and equal to the individual file number; digit count and check algorithm not stated. Applications for under-12s made by a guardian (art. 18), so no minimum age. A new card has been issued since 2018 (EU/Portugal-funded, per Wikipedia) and its format/MRZ were not found; the 2004 rules may have been superseded.

name: Mauritian passport / Passeport mauricien
notes: Issued under the Passport Act 1969 / Passport Regulations 1969 (no renewal after expiry, new application needed). Data page (Wikipedia) shows Type P, code MUS, Passport No., ..., 'Personal No.' (National Identity Card number) and ends with the MRZ (td3); English and French. Passport office fee page distinguishes adult/young person, minor below 16, senior 55+ but states no validity periods; validity not found. Number format unknown (no specimen).

name: Mauritius National Identity Card (MNIC 2.0, smart card) / Carte d'identité nationale
notes: Card number: Card Control Number / Card Body Number (CBN), a '9-character identifier printed on the reverse' that uniquely identifies the card (MNIS FAQ; character set not stated, so *{9}). Separate National Identity Card Number (the personal number, also on passports as 'Personal No.' and in the back barcode) - format not given by MNIS (commonly 14 chars: surname initial + DDMMYY + digits + check letter; unconfirmed). MNIC 2.0 issued from Oct 2013, valid 20 years from issue; MNIC 1.0 laminated cards no longer valid. First registration at 18. Chip + barcode; new security features (VDS QR code, translucent window) from 19 Feb 2024 (mnis.govmu.org). MRZ not mentioned.

name: Eswatini passport (Kingdom of Eswatini / Swaziland)

notes: Only a blank (unpersonalised) card image found; it shows fields "Broj lične karte / ID serial number" and "Datum važenja / Date of expiry" but no number, and no back/MRZ. Card number format unknown. JMBG (13 digits) is a separate field. en.wikipedia (older text) says 5 years validity, eligibility 14, compulsory 16 and carried from 18; the consolidated law (as summarised by search, amendments to 2014) says 10 years, 4 years under 4, 40 years over 65, so cards are issuable from birth (min_age 0). A newer eID card (PRADO MNE-BO-03001) exists; not examined. Validity source is a search snippet only.

name: Maltese passport (Passaport ta' Malta)
mrz_optional: none (optional field empty on sample)
notes: Purview 'seven digits' confirmed by the 2010-issued sample data page (issued 26 JUN 2010, expires 26 JUN 2020: same_day). Validity from Identita FAQ 56-59 (0-9: 2 y, 10-15: 5 y, 16+: 10 y); en.wikipedia's '5 years under 16' is out of date/incomplete. New number on every renewal (FAQ 20). Series: 2008 paper data page (in circulation to ~2029) and 2019 polycarbonate data page (Regula blog); number shape of the 2019 series not confirmed on a specimen. Place-of-birth printed as code (BVT) on sample.

name: Maltese identity card / eID (Karta tal-Identità)
mrz_optional: line 1: ID number (7 digits + letter, e.g. 0000000M); line 2: 6 digits 200910 (probably date of issue YYMMDD)
notes: MRZ document number = card/document number, which changes with every card issued (Identita); specimen shows 8 digits (check digit verified). Separate permanent ID number (Identita, Purview, Wikipedia agree): #{7}[MGAPLHBZ] - first 5 digits = Public Registry birth registration number, last 2 = registration year; letter M=Malta 1900-1999, L=Malta 2000+, G=Gozo 1900-1999, H=Gozo 2000+, B=Malta 1800s, Z=Gozo 1800s, P=born abroad without original certificate, A=foreign resident permit holder; leading zeros kept (0000000M). The ID number is also the Maltese TIN. Validity: cards issued at 14 expire 1 month after 16th birthday, at 16 expire 1 month after 18th birthday, all others 10 years (Identita). Specimen issue 2020-09-10 (from MRZ) / expiry 2030-09-09 -> day_before (inferred from MRZ only). EU-standard card (Reg. 2019/1157) since Aug 2020; old-format cards invalid from 1 Jan 2016. Card also shows CAN and a printed serial (ID03779). Compulsory at 18 (Wikipedia).

name: National Identity Card / ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތެއްކަން އަންގައިދޭ ކާޑު, Department of National Registration
notes: ID number commonly seen as 'A' + 6 digits (e.g. A123456) but no source found confirming it - left empty. name: Passaporte electrónico comum / Passport (República de Cabo Verde)
mrz_optional: unknown (data page shows 'Número de identificação', i.e. the NIC)
notes: Decreto-Lei 21/2014 of 17 March 2014 (B.O. I série n.º 19) creates the Cape Verdean e-passport: polycarbonate-laminated data page, contactless ICAO chip with BAC/EAC; data page fields include passport number, 'número de identificação' (NIC, see CV id_card: #{8}[MF]#{3}#) and expiry; page perforation with the passport number. Art.30: ordinary passport valid 5 years; 2 years for minors under 4; not extendable. Ordinary passport number format not stated in the decree (the temporary passport is numbered with one letter + 6 digits, art.52 - not the ordinary series). Commons: covers only (File:Cape_Verde_Passport_1.jpg, _2.jpg). ~190,000 e-passports issued in three years (noticiasaominuto).

name: Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI) / National Identity Card
mrz_optional: unknown (NIC likely)
notes: Decreto-Lei 19/2014 of 17 March 2014 (B.O. I série n.º 19): polycarbonate chip card (CNI/CPV), compulsory from age 4 (pre-school), optional from birth registration; MRZ on the back (art.5; card-sized so td1); validity fixed by portaria of the minister for civil identification (art.24) - portaria not found. Card document number (número de documento, art.15.5) is separate from the NIC and changes with each card; its format not found. NIC (Número de Identificação Civil, art.15, issuer law): 'aaaammddsxxxc' = birth year (4) + month (2) + day (2) + sex letter M/F + 3-digit sequence (max 999 per sex per day) + 1 check digit (algorithm not given) -> #{8}[MF]#{3}# (en-wiki states the same). Old paper BI (since 1957) phased out. Same supplier/design family as the Portuguese Cartão de Cidadão (en-wiki).

name: Icelandic passport (Vegabréf)
number_source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Icelandic_Passport_(2019)_-_Biodata_page.jpg (en.wikipedia Icelandic passport data-page image, 2019 specimen; file name from wp/datapage_files.json, image read in the first run as img/IS-pp)
validity_source: https://island.is/vegabref ('Vegabréf gilda í tíu ár frá umsóknardegi en í fimm ár fyrir börn yngri en 18 ára' - via search snippet)
mrz_optional: kennitala as DDMMYY<NNNN (e.g. 121212<1239)
notes: 2019 specimen (SPECIMEN Þæó Specimen, Þjóðskrá Íslands): no. A3501291 = 1 letter + 7 digits, document type 'PA', issued 11 FEB 2019, expires 04 FEB 2029: validity runs 10 years from the APPLICATION date, not the issue date (island.is: 'frá umsóknardegi'), so expiry = application date + N years and falls a few days before issue + N; generator should pick an application date 0-30 days before issue. MRZ PAISLSPECIMEN<<THAEOE<SPECIMEN<<< / A3501291<5ISL1212123F2902049121212<1239<<<62: personal-number field = kennitala (10 digits DDMMYY-NNNN, printed 121212-1239). 6-digit CAN. Letter series meaning unknown (one specimen). Issuer Þjóðskrá (Registers Iceland), applications via sýslumenn.

name: Icelandic identity card (Nafnskírteini; travel version 'Nafnskírteini ferðaskilríki')
validity_source: https://www.althingi.is/lagas/nuna/2023055.html (Lög um nafnskírteini 55/2023: 'Nafnskírteini skal gilda í tíu ár frá útgáfudegi en í fimm ár fyrir börn yngri en 18 ára')
mrz_optional: kennitala as DDMMYY<NNNN in line 1 (121212<1239)
notes: New card under Act 55/2023, issued from March 2024 by Þjóðskrá: vertical-format TD1 card (portrait layout, MRZ on the back reading vertically) in two versions, with travel rights (Icelandic citizens of any age, valid in the EEA) and without. Specimen (ÆVARSDÓTTIR Þuríður Ösp): no. ID0001217 ('ID' + 7 digits; low serial, likely specimen/placeholder - shape only), issued 04 MAR 2024, expires 01 MAR 2034 - again a few days short of issue + 10 y although the Act says 'frá útgáfudegi', so expiry rule unknown (probably application date as for passports). Back prints kennitala 121212-1239 and a 6-digit CAN. Old nafnskírteini (1965-2024 law: laminated paper, no number, no expiry) no longer issued. All citizens regardless of age ('óháð aldri', skra.is).

name: Vanuatu Passport / Passeport de Vanuatu (English, French, Bislama)

UNDP: >230,000 holders (~77% of population).

name: Liechtenstein passport (Reisepass, Fürstentum Liechtenstein)
mrz_optional: none (personal-number field empty on specimen)
notes: Current specimen (new series, Commons PD, issue 03.02.2026 / expiry 02.02.2036 -> day_before) shows passport no. PP0000000 (placeholder zeros; 'PP' may be a fixed series prefix, unconfirmed) and MRZ document type 'PP' (not 'P<'); MRZ check digit of PP0000000 = 0 consistent. Older 2006 biometric series (en.wikipedia fair-use sample, issue 27.12.2006 / expiry 26.12.2016 -> day_before) shows number 'R 00000' (R + 5 digits, placeholder) in MRZ as R00000<<<. Validity: Heimatschriftengesetz (HSchG, LGBl. 1986 Nr. 27) Art. 19 as of 01.02.2026: 10 years if 12th birthday reached at application, 5 years if under 12; not extendable (en.wikipedia's 0-12/13-17 split is off by one). Data page also prints CAN. PEID (personal identification number) is on the ID card; not seen on passport. Llv.li pages return HTTP 403 to scripts. [merge 2026-11-04] 'PP' is also the MRZ document type code; do not encode it as a series prefix without a second source.

name: Liechtenstein identity card (Identitätskarte)

name: Monégasque identity card (Carte d'identité monégasque, CIME)
mrz_optional: none visible on 2009 specimen
notes: Shape from one low-resolution 2009 specimen (en.wikipedia fair-use, marked SPECIMEN): card 'N° 029067', MRZ line 1 'I<MCO029067<<<0' (document type I<, 6-digit number + fillers, check digit 0 verified); a printed serial 'PR-000001' also appears on the back. Issued by the Mairie de Monaco (Service de l'état civil et de la nationalité); biometric chip since 30 Mar 2009. A newer card (first issued 2021 per PRADO listing MCO-BO-02001) exists; its number format is not confirmed. Validity conflict: en.wikipedia says 5 years; Ordonnance Souveraine n° 15.535 (2002, via refworld snippet) says 10 years for persons over 16, issued without age condition, minors could be added as an annex to a parent's card - left empty. mairie.mc CIME page now 404. Wikipedia lists the card as compulsory.

name: San Marino passport (Passaporto della Repubblica di San Marino)
notes: No number format found: Commons has no data page (only stamps/visas), Purview has no San Marino definition, PRADO not reachable (search snippets list SMR-AO-02001 e-passport first issued ~12 Oct 2006 and a newer SMR-AO-03001). Validity from Legge 16 giugno 2004 n.79 (norme sul rilascio del passaporto ordinario) Art. 6: adults 10 years from date of issue; minors 'da 0 a 3 anni: 3 anni; da 3 a 14 anni: 5 anni; da 14 anni: 10 anni' (age boundaries as written are overlapping; read as 0-2 / 3-13 / 14+). Earlier: 1962 law 2 years, 1984 law 5 years. Issued by the Dipartimento Affari Esteri. en.wikipedia infobox matches the 2004 law.

name: San Marino identity card (Carta d'identità, electronic CIE)
notes: Decreto Delegato 7 gennaio 2025 n.2 (replacing DD 7 ott 2024 n.152; DD 18 gen 2017 n.8 abrogated from 30 Nov 2024), Art. 2(4): document number = 9 digits, first 4 are '2003', remaining 5 unique starting at 00001, +1 per issue; separate 'numero identificativo unico del supporto' = 6 digits, first digit 1, rest from 50000 upward (i.e. 1[5-9]#{4} at first) on the back; back also shows the codice ISS (personal social-security number, shape not found). Art. 4: validity 5 years, 3 years under age 6; older cards valid to natural expiry. Issued to citizens and resident foreigners of any age (signature not required under 12; travel-valid card for minors needs parental consent); Law 83/2004 originally set minimum 14 and 5 years. 2017 card template (Commons, PD) shows placeholder '000000000' (9 digits) and an empty 3-line TD1 MRZ, with 'valida / non valida per l'espatrio' variants; MRZ optional content not seen. Expiry rule not seen on a specimen. Example left empty (no real specimen of the 2024 series).

name: Republic of Palau Passport (English)
validity_source: https://pacliirms.austlii.edu.au/pw/legis/consol_act/pncgpt1409.pdf (Palau National Code Title 13 ch. 12 s.1208 as amended by RPPL 6-31: regular passport valid 5 years for a person under 16 and 10 years for a person at least 16; s.1209 (RPPL 7-3): only machine-readable passports valid from 1 Jan 2007; via search snippet)
notes: Passports issued since 8 Dec 1994, centrally at the Passport Office, Meyuns; non-machine-readable passports invalid from 1 Jan 2007 (Wikipedia, RPPL 7-3). Fee USD 50 (Wikipedia, old embassy form). Wikipedia infobox '10 years' agrees for adults. PRADO lists a Palau official passport (PLW-AS-02001), not consulted. No data-page specimen found; number format unknown.

name: (none for citizens; Republic of Palau Identification Card / Digital Residency ID for foreigners)
validity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_national_identity_card_policies_by_country (Palau: 'Republic of Palau Identification Cards are primarily issued to foreign nationals ... under the Digital Residency Act')

name: Vatican City State ordinary passport (Passaporto, Stato della Città del Vaticano)
notes: Issuer sheets (epass.vatican.va): ordinary passport issued centrally by the Governorate, to Vatican citizens only (Holy See diplomatic/service passports are separate, out of scope). Versions: A 2008-06-01..2013-10-14 (32 pp), B 2013-10-15..2020-09-30 (fingerprint chip from 2016-11-01), C 2020-10-01..2025-12-17 (polycarbonate, 50 pp), D from 2025-12-18 (MRZ type indicator 'PP' instead of 'PV', PACE). Validity conflict: general-information sheet says 'Validity 5 years (max)' for all versions; the Dec-2025 sheet for version D says 'Max validity 10 years'; recorded 10 (newest). A UV facsimile data page in the 2025 sheet (version C, type PV) shows issue '02 GEN/JAN 20?0' and expiry '01 GEN/JAN 2030' (issue year blurred) -> day_before, 10 years; its passport number is barely legible ('PV' + about 7 digits, looks like zeros) so no pattern recorded. Renewal on page 4 for max 6 months turns it into an emergency travel document. ICAO code VAT. Commons has covers only.

name: Vatican identity card (Carta d'identità, Stato della Città del Vaticano)
notes: Legal basis only: Legge n. III del 7 giugno 1929 sulla cittadinanza ed il soggiorno, Art. 11: Vatican citizens must obtain an identity card issued by the Governor (cardinals, their entourage and others exempt); a later citizenship law (2011, per search snippet) keeps an Art. 5 'Carta d'identità' issued by the Governatorato to Vatican citizens under regulation - text not retrieved (WIPO S3 copy blocked). en.wikipedia: the Holy See issues ID cards to Vatican citizens, unclear if compulsory. No number format, validity, specimen or MRZ information found; card may not be an ICAO travel document. Only ~600 citizens.
